v: Ayik ix ak'ji ganar heb' amalecita yuj winhaj David, ix meltzaj winh t'a Siclag. Haxo t'a schab'ji'al sk'ochxi winh ta', ix k'och jun winh kelem spetoj t'a scampamento winhaj Saúl, toxo ix snhik'chitejb'at spichul winh ayochi, aypaxk'e lum lum t'a skal xil sjolom winh, yik sch'oxanel winh to ay skusk'olal winh. Haxo ix k'och winh t'a yichanh winhaj David chi', ix em nhojan winh.
Ix sk'anb'an winhaj David chi' t'a winh: --¿B'ajtil hach koti? xchi winh. --Toxonhej ix hin el lemnaj t'a scampamento heb' etisraelal, xchi winh.

--¿Tas ix uji jun? Al jab'ok wab'i, xchi winhaj David chi'. --Ix ak'ji ganar heb' etisraelal chi'. Ay heb' ixto elkani, ay heb' ix chami. Ix champax winhaj Saúl yet' winh yuninal, haton winhaj Jonatán, xchi winh.
--¿Tas ix aj ojtakaneli tato ix cham winhaj Saúl yet' winh yuninal chi'? xchi winhaj David chi'.

Ix tak'wi winh: --K'inh wal ayinek' t'a witzal Gilboa, ix wilani to toxonhej nhojanem winhaj Saúl chi' t'a yib'anh k'e'en slanza. Tzak'anxo wal sk'och heb' ajk'o'ol chi' t'a spatik winh yet' scarruaje heb' yik owal yet' heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej.
Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix b'at k'elnaj winh t'a spatik, ix hin yilanb'at winh, ix hin yawtankot winh. --Tik ayin mamin, xin chi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'ayin b'ajtil hin koti. Ix walan t'a winh to amalecita hin.
Ix yalanxi winh t'ayin to tzin nitzb'at hin b'a t'a stz'ey, tzin milancham winh t'a jun'elnhej yalani. Mok chi' pitzanto winh, palta toxo ix och pitz'an sya'il t'a sk'o'ol winh.

Yuj chi' ix hin nitzb'at hin b'a t'a stz'ey winh, ix hin wach' milancham winh yik max ste ab'ej sya'il, yujto ix wila' to toxowal scham winh, yujto toxo ix em winh t'a yib'anh snhi' k'e'en slanza chi'. Ayik ix lajwi scham winh chi', ix wik'anel scorona winh t'a sjolom yet' brazalete ayoch t'a sk'ab' winh, ix wik'ankot t'ayach mamin, xchi winh.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj David chi' icha chi', ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh yuj kusk'olal yet' heb' ajun yet'ok.

Ix te ok' heb' yuj schamel winhaj Saúl yet' winh yuninal chi', haton winhaj Jonatán, yujto toxo ix ak'ji ganar heb' soldado israel schonhab' Jehová yuj heb' filisteo. Majxo walaj heb' yuj kusk'olal masanto ix em k'u.

Ixlajwi chi' ix sk'anb'an winhaj David t'a winh kelem ix ik'ankot ab'ix chi': --¿B'ajtil aljinak hach? xchi winh. --Ha hin tik yuninal hin jun winh amalecita ayek' kajan t'a he kal tik, xchi winh kelem chi'.
--¿Tas yuj ix ha tek'b'ej ha b'a ha milancham winh sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová chi'? xchi winhaj David chi'.
Ix lajwinhej chi', ix yawtankot jun soldado winhaj David chi': --Milcham jun winak tik, xchi winh. Wal chi' ix miljicham winh kelem chi'.
Ayik wan smiljicham winh chi', ix yalan winhaj David chi': --Ha hach ay ha mul yuj chi' tzach chami. Ha hach ix alelta ha mul chi' to ix ha milcham winh rey sik'b'iloch yuj Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix sb'itej jun b'it tik winhaj David yuj kusk'olal yuj schamel winhaj Saúl yet' winhaj Jonatán.
Ha jun b'it tik, ix chekji sk'ayb'ej masanil heb' aj Judá yuj winh. Ix stz'ib'chajpaxkan t'a yol ch'anh slibro winhaj Jaser:
Hex wetisraelal, ob'iltak ix aj yak'ji ganar sb'inajnakil ko chonhab' t'a witzal Gilboa. Ay... tas wal yuj ix ak'ji ganar heb' niwak winak yaj t'a ko kal.

Manh heyal yab' heb' aj chonhab' Gat tas ix uji, manh heyalel t'a yoltak scalle'al Ascalón, yik wach' max tzalaj heb' ix filistea, yik wach' max k'e chennaj heb' ix ch'ok chonhab'il chi' yuj tzalajk'olal.

Manhxo'okab' em nhab' yet' yal ak'wal t'a yib'anh witzal Gilboa chi', yik maxtzak k'ib' tas tz'ak'ji t'a ofrenda'il, yujto hata' ix laj tek'jikan smaklab' jul-lab' heb' winh soldado yik Israel te tek'an. Hata' ix satel skopopi'al yilji smaklab' jul-lab' winhaj Saúl.

Juntakel ix meltzaj winhaj Saúl yet' winhaj Jonatán t'a owal, chik'tak, ma xepu'tak k'e'en yespada heb' winh yet' sjul-lab'. Malaj b'aj smeltzaj heb' winh t'a ichnhejta', ha heb' ajk'o'ol niwak yelk'ochi, ha heb' smilcham heb' winh.
Hach Saúl yet' hach Jonatán, te nib'ab'il hex. Junnhej heyaji ayik pitzan hex, junnhej pax ix aj he chami. Te jelan he b'ey t'a yichanh nok' ch'akb'a. Te ay heyip t'a yichanh nok' choj.
Hex ix aj Israel, ok'anhek yuj winhaj Saúl. Ix heyak'och k'apak pichul chakchak yet' pax lino te wach' yuj winh, ix yak'an oro winh yelwanub'ok he pichul.
Ay... tas wal ix aj yak'ji ganar heb' niwak winak t'a owal. Ix miljicham winhaj Jonatán t'a jolomtak witz.
Hach wuk'tak aj Jonatán, tzin te kus hu'uj. Manhxa yalb'anil jantak ha wach'il ix ak' t'ayin. Ha wal b'aj hin ha xajanejnak, ek'to t'a yichanh b'aj tzonh xajanej heb' ix ix.
Ay... tas ix aj scham heb' winh soldado te tek'an. Masanil syamk'ab' heb' winh ak'um owal ix satkaneli, xchi winhaj David chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an winhaj David t'a Jehová icha tik: --¿Tom syal hin k'exk'och t'a yol junok chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Syala', xchi. Ix sk'anb'anpax winh: --¿Mach junok chonhab' b'aj syal hin k'ochi? xchi winh. --Ha t'a chonhab' Hebrón syal ha k'ochi, xchi Jehová chi'.
Yuj chi', hata' ix b'at winhaj David chi' yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum schawanhil, haton ix Ahinoam aj Jezreel yet' ix Abigail yetb'eyumkan winhaj xilb'a Nabal, aj Carmel.
Ix yik'anpaxb'at heb' winh ayek' yet' winh yet' yetb'eyum junjun heb' yet' yal yuninal heb'. Ix kajnaj heb' t'a Hebrón yet' t'a yaldea'il.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och heb' yichamtak winakil yinhtilal Judá t'a winhaj David chi', ix yak'ankanoch winh heb' sreyalok. Ix yab'an winhaj David to ha heb' aj Jabes t'a yol yik Galaad ix mukan winhaj Saúl,
yuj chi' ix yak'b'at juntzanh heb' schekab' winh, yik b'at yal heb' t'a heb' icha tik: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'ayex yuj tastak wach' ix he k'ulej yujto ix he muk winhaj Saúl ko reyal.
Ha tikne'ik a'okab' Jehová tz'ok' sk'o'ol t'ayex, tzex xajanani, hanhejtona' pax hin ha hin tik, wach' ol wutej hin b'a t'ayex yuj tas ix he k'ulej chi'.
Yuj chi', ak'ek heyip, tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, wach'chom ix cham winhaj Saúl ko reyal chi', palta ha masanil heb' yinhtilal Judá ix hin ak'anoch sreyalok, xchib'at winhaj David chi'.
Haxo ix aji, ha winhaj Abner yuninal winhaj Ner, yajalil masanil heb' soldado winhaj Saúl, ha winh ix ik'anb'at winhaj Is-boset yuninal winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Mahanaim.
Hata' ix yak'kanoch winh sreyalok juntzanh chonhab' tik: Haton Galaad, Gesuri, Jezreel, Efraín, Benjamín yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' yik Israel.

Ha winhaj Is-boset chi', 40 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal t'a chonhab' Israel chi', chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh, palta haxo heb' yinhtilal Judá, ha winhaj David ayxo och sreyalok heb'.
Nanhal swajxakil ab'il ix yak' reyal winhaj David chi' t'a heb' yinhtilal Judá t'a chonhab' Hebrón.
Icha tik ix aj yoch owal. Ha winhaj Abner chi', ix el winh t'a Mahanaim, ix b'atkan winh t'a Gabaón yet' heb' soldado yik winhaj Is-boset.

Haxo winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia, ix el winh yet' heb' soldado winhaj David t'a Hebrón, ix schalaj sb'a winh yet' winhaj Abner b'aj smolb'ej sb'a ha ha' t'a yik Gabaón. Ha chab' makan heb' soldado chi', ix k'och heb' t'a ha ha' chi', junjun makan heb' ix kan t'a junjun sk'axepal ha'.
Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Abner t'a winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --Elokab'kot jaywanhok heb' winh kelemtak yak' owal t'a kichanh tik, xchi winh. --Ichokab'ta', xchi winhaj Joab chi'.

Yuj chi' ix elta heb' winh, lajannhej sb'isul yik junjun heb' winh ix elta, lajchawanh heb' winh t'a yinhtilal Benjamín ayoch yet' winhaj Is-boset chi', lajchawanh pax heb' winh yik winhaj David chi' ix elta.

Junjun heb' winh ix syam sjolom heb' yajk'o'ol heb' winh chi', ix stiplanoch k'e'en yespada heb' winh t'a skostil junjun, yuj chi' junnhej ix aj scham heb' winh smasanil. Yuj chi' “Teklajb'a'il” ix sb'i'ejkan jun lugar chi', ha t'a yol yik Gabaón chi' ay.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', te niwan ix aj yoch owal yuj heb' winh. Ix ak'ji ganar winhaj Abner yet' heb' soldado yuj heb' soldado winhaj David chi'.
Hata' ayoch oxwanh heb' winh yune' ix Sarvia, haton winhaj Joab, winhaj Abisai yet' winhaj Asael. Ha winhaj Asael chi' te jelan sb'ey winh icha nok' k'ultakil chej.
Ix och jinhan winh t'a spatik winhaj Abner, majxo yal-laj yel winhaj Abner chi'.
Ayik ix yilanb'at winh t'a spatik, ix yalan winh: --Mato ha hach Asael hach chi', xchi winh. --Ha hin toni, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Abner chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Aktej hin ha pechani, a'okab' junok heb' winh kelem tik tza yama', tzik'ankan masanil tastak yet'nak, xchi winh t'a winh. Palta haxo winhaj Asael chi' jun, maj yal-laj sk'o'ol winh syaktej spechan winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Abner chi' t'a winh jun'elxo: --Aktej hin ha pechani, ¿mato tzin ak' wal pural yik tzach hin milanchamok? Tato icha chi', ¿tas ol aj hin sat hin k'och t'a yichanh winh uk'tak aj Joab? xchi winh.

Palta ha winhaj Asael chi', maj yaktej winh spechan winh, yuj chi' haxo yok slanza winhaj Abner chi' ix stipkot t'a spatik, ha wal t'a sk'o'ol winhaj Asael chi' ix ochi, ix k'axpajelk'och te' t'a yich spatik winh. Ix telwi winh, ix cham winh. Masanil mach sk'och t'a jun lugar b'aj ix cham winh chi' tz'och wan heb' yila'.

Haxo winhaj Joab yet' winhaj Abisai ix b'atnhej heb' winh t'a spatik winhaj Abner chi'. Ayik wanxo yem k'u, ix k'och heb' winh t'a sjolom lum witz Amma, ay t'a yichanh Gía, haton b'aj sb'atkan sb'e'al juntzanh tzinan lu'um t'a Gabaón.
Hata' ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín yet' winhaj Abner chi', junxonhej ix yutej sb'a heb' smasanil t'a jun tzalan.

Haxo winhaj Abner chi' ix awaj t'a winhaj Joab icha tik: --¿Tom manh ol aktej ha milancham anima tik? ¿Tom max ha na' jab'ok to anhej chukal syik'kot jun tik t'a kib'anh? ¿Janik' ol al t'a heb' ha soldado to tz'och wa'an heb' spechan heb' yetchonhab'? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --Syil wal Dios, k'inalok maj hach awajok, ix am honh b'atnhej t'a he patik masanto t'a k'inhib'alil k'ik'an, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' to spuji nok' ch'a'ak, yuj chi' ix och wa'an masanil heb' soldado yik winhaj David spechan heb' yik Israel chi'.
Haxo winhaj Abner chi' yet' heb' soldado pilan ak'wal ix b'ey heb' t'a spanhanil Arabá, ix k'axpajek' heb' t'a ha' Jordán yet' t'a yol yik Bitrón masanto ix k'och heb' t'a Mahanaim.

Haxo pax winhaj Joab chi', ix och wa'an winh spechan winhaj Abner chi'. Ichato chi' ix smolb'an heb' soldado winh smasanil, ix yawtan slista'il heb' winh, haxo ix aji to ay 19 heb' soldado yik winhaj David chi' ix chami, ix champax winhaj Asael.
Palta haxo heb' soldado yik Benjamín yet'nak winhaj Abner, 360 heb' ix cham yuj heb' soldado yik winhaj David chi'.

Ha winhaj Joab yet' masanil heb' soldado, pilan ak'wal ix b'ey heb', ayxo'ek' heb' t'a Hebrón ix k'inhib'i. Ayik wan smeltzaj heb', ix ek' heb' yik' sniwanil winhaj Asael chi'. Ha b'aj mukan smam winh t'a chonhab' Belén, hata' ix mukji winh.

Ha heb' soldado ayoch yet' winh yuninal winhaj Saúl chi', najtil ix yak' owal heb' yet' heb' ayoch yet' winhaj David, palta jab'jab'il ix el yip heb', haxo pax heb' yik winhaj David chi' ix te tek'k'aj heb'.

Ha heb' yuninal winhaj David ix alji t'a Hebrón, haton sb'i heb' tik t'a stzolal: Winhaj Amnón yune' ix Ahinoam aj Jezreel, winhaj Quileab, yune' ix Abigail, ix yetb'eyumkan winhaj xilb'a Nabal, aj Carmel, winhaj Absalón yune' ix Maaca yisil winhaj Talmai sreyal Gesur, winhaj Adonías yune' ix Haguit, winhaj Sefatías yune' ix Abital yet' winhaj Itream yune' ix Egla. Haton sb'i heb' ix yetb'eyum winhaj David tik yet' heb' yuninal ix alji ayik ayek' winh t'a Hebrón.
Ayik aynhej och owal t'a skal heb' yik winhaj David yet' heb' ayoch yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Saúl, haxo winhaj Abner chi' ix ste ik'ej yipok winh t'a skal heb' yik winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ha winhaj Saúl chi', aykan jun ix yetb'eyum winh skuchan Rizpa, yisil winhaj Aja. Ay jun k'u ix yal winhaj Is-boset t'a winhaj Abner chi': --¿Tas yuj ix hach way yet' ix yetb'eyumkan winh hin mam? xchi winh t'a winh.

Yujto ix yal jun chi' winhaj Is-boset chi' t'a winhaj Abner chi', yuj chi' ix te kot yowal winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --¿Tom tz'i' hin tzila', tokwal wan wak'anoch hin b'a yet' heb' ajk'o'ol yik Judá tik? Ha hin tik, te wach'nhej ix wutej hin b'a t'a heb' ayto yuj sb'a yet' winh ha mam yet' t'a heb' wach' yak'an yet' winh, maj hach wak'paxoch t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj David, haxo tikne'ik tzak'an yowalil t'ayin yuj jun ix ix chi'.

Ha Jehová ix yak' sti' t'a winhaj David to tz'ik'ji'ek' opisio t'a winhaj Saúl yet' pax t'a heb' yinhtilal, tz'ochkan winhaj David chi' reyal t'a Israel yet' t'a Judá, skotnhej t'a chonhab' Dan masanto t'a Beerseba. Kotokab' yowal sk'o'ol Jehová t'a wib'anh tato max wak' wip yelk'och tas ix yal chi', xchi winh.
Majxo yal-laj yalan junok b'elanh lolonel winhaj Is-boset t'a winhaj Abner chi', yujto xiwnak winh t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at juntzanh schekab' winhaj Abner chi' yal t'a winhaj David icha tik: ¿Tom manhok hin ay wopisio t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik? Ha tikne'ik ko b'o junok ko trato yik tzin och het'ok, yik wach' masanil heb' ketchonhab' tz'och heb' het'ok, xchib'at winh.

Ix yalan winhaj David chi': Syal hin b'o'an hin trato chi' het'ok, palta ay jun tas yowalil tzojtakejeli: Max yal-laj ha jawi t'a wichanh tato manh et'nakok ix wetb'eyum, ix Mical yisilkan winhaj xilb'a Saúl, xchib'at winh.

Ix schekanpaxb'at heb' schekab' winhaj David chi' t'a winhaj Is-boset, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ak'kot ix Mical, ix wetb'eyum, haton ix wik'nak yik wak'annak jun ciento sjolom swinakil heb' winh filisteo yuj stojolok ix t'a winh smam, xchib'at winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Is-boset chi' to tz'ik'ji'ek' ix t'a winh yetb'eyum, haton winhaj Paltiel, yuninal winhaj Lais.
Ha winhaj Paltiel chi', ix b'at tzak'an winh yuj ix, ix och ijan winh yok'i, masanto ix k'och winh t'a Bahurim. Hata' ix yal winhaj Abner chi' t'a winh to smeltzaj winh, yuj chi' ix meltzajkan winh.
Yakb'an chi', ix laj lolon winhaj Abner yet' heb' yichamtak winakil Israel, ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Ayxo stiempo'al ix he na' ha hex tik to ha winhaj David tz'och he reyalok.

Ha tikne'ik jun, toxo ix k'och stiempo'al yik tz'och winh, yujto yalnakkan Jehová yuj winh schekab' chi', to ha winh ol kolan schonhab' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo yet' t'a yol sk'ab' masanil juntzanh heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh, xchi winh.

Ix lolonpax winh yet' masanil heb' yetchonhab' aj Benjamín, ix lajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a Hebrón yik slolon winh yet' winhaj David yuj tas ix yal heb' yetisraelal heb' yet' tas ix yal masanil heb' yetchonhab' heb' aj Benjamín chi'.
Ix k'och winh yet' 20 heb' soldado t'a Hebrón b'aj ayek' winhaj David chi'. Ix schekan b'ojok jun niwan wa'el winhaj David chi' yuj winhaj Abner yet' pax yuj heb' ajun yet' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Abner chi' t'a winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik mamin rey, yowalil tzin b'at hin molb'ej masanil heb' ketisraelal, yik sb'o'an junok trato heb' het'ok, icha wal chi' ol aj ak'an reyal icha wal tas tza nib'ej, xchi winh. --Ixik an, xchi winhaj David chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalankan kilkob'a winhaj Abner chi', ix b'at winh t'a tzalajk'olal.

Hato wal sb'at winhaj Abner chi', ix k'och winhaj Joab yet' heb' soldado winhaj David, spetoj heb' t'a owal. Te tzijtum tastak yet'nak heb', haton tas ix laj yik'ek' heb' t'a heb' yajk'o'ol. Ayik ix k'och winhaj Joab yet' masanil heb' soldado ajun yet'ok, ix alji t'a winh to ha winhaj Abner chi', ix ulek' winh lolonel yet' winh rey chi', toxo ix meltzaj winh t'a tzalajk'olal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Joab chi' t'a winh rey chi', ix yalan winh: --Mamin rey, ¿tas yuj icha chi' ix ha k'ulej? Yujto ha winhaj Abner ix ulek' t'ayach, ix ha cha'anxib'at winh t'a tzalajk'olal.
Mamin rey ¿tom manh ojtakok to ha winhaj Abner chi' tonhej tzul smusej ha sat winh yik syil winh tas tza k'ulej yet' tas aji? xchi winh.

Ixnhej lajwi slolon winh yet' winh rey chi', ix schekan winh b'at saychaj winhaj Abner chi' t'a elk'altak, hato b'aj ay ha' uk'b'ila' yik Sira, hata' ix meltzaj winh yuj heb', palta manh yojtakoklaj winhaj David chi' tas yaji.

Ayik ix jax winhaj Abner chi' t'a Hebrón, haxo winhaj Joab chi' ix cha'an winh sjawi t'a spatikel chonhab' chi', ix ik'jib'at winh yuj winh t'a stz'eyb'at sti' jun chonhab' chi', yik slolon heb' winh ta' sch'okoj. Hata' ix stipoch yespada winhaj Joab chi' t'a sk'o'ol winh, ix cham winh, yik syak'anek' spak winh yuk'tak winhaj Joab chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj David, ix yalan winh: Syil Jehová to ha hin tik yet' masanil heb' hin chekab' malaj kalan kik t'a schamel winhaj Abner chi'.

Kotokab'kan jun tik t'a yib'anh winhaj Joab yet' t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal winh yet' heb' sk'ab' yok. Ha t'a skal heb', ayokab' mach ol yab' sya'il yuj tas tz'el t'a sniwanil, ayokab' mach ol pena'ayax yuj lepra, ayokab'pax mach tz'em sb'eyi, ayokab' mach smiljichamok yet' mach scham yuj wejel, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ha winhaj Joab chi' yet' winhaj Abisai ix milancham winhaj Abner chi', yujto ayik ix och owal t'a Gabaón, ha winhaj Abner chi' ix milancham winhaj Asael, winh yuk'tak heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey t'a winhaj Joab chi' yet' t'a masanil heb' ajun yet' winh to snhik'chitejel spichul heb', yik tz'och heb' t'a kusk'olal yuj schamel winhaj Abner chi'. Ix och tzak'an winh rey chi' t'a spatik mach ix b'akhanb'at sniwanil winh chi'.
Ha t'a Hebrón ix smuk sniwanil winh chi' heb'. Ix ok' winh rey chi' b'aj ix mukchaj winhaj Abner chi', ix ok'pax masanil heb' anima ajun yet' winh.
Yuj chi' ix sb'itej jun b'it yik kusk'olal winh rey chi': Hach Abner ¿tas yuj icha chi' ix aj ha chami? Icha tz'aj scham heb' sk'ulan chukal ix aj ha chami.

Tokwal tzek'b'il ha k'ab', ma tzek'b'il ok t'a k'e'en cadena. Icha wal tz'aj scham junok mach t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima te chuk sb'eyb'al, icha chi' ix aj ha chami, xchi winhaj David chi'. Haxo heb' anima chi', ix ok'pax heb' yuj schamel winhaj Abner chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj David chi' to swa jab'ok winh yakb'an manto em k'u, palta ix yak' sti' winh t'a yichanh Dios: --A'okab' Dios tz'ak'anoch yahelal t'a wib'anh tato swab'lej jab'ok wa'el ma junokxo tasi ayik manto em k'u, xchi winh.
Masanil anima ayek' ta', ix nachajel jun chi' yuj heb', ix scha wal sk'o'ol heb', yujto masanil tas sk'ulej winhaj David chi' scha sk'o'ol heb' anima smasanil.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix nachajel yuj heb' israel chi' smasanil to ha winhaj rey David chi', manh lokanoklaj winh t'a schamel winhaj Abner chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a masanil heb' schekab': --Ojtakejekeli to ha tikne'ik ix cham jun winh sat yajal t'a ko kal ha honh israel honh tik.
Yuj chi' wach'chom ha Dios ix hin sik'anoch reyal, palta ste el wip swab' yuj schuk spensaril heb' winh yune' ix Sarvia. A'okab' Jehová ol ak'an spak t'a jun mach ix k'ulan chukal tik, xchi winh.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Is-boset yuninal winhaj Saúl to toxo ix cham winhaj Abner t'a Hebrón, ix te xiw winh. Ix te somchajpaxk'e masanil heb' yetisraelal winh yet'ok.

Ay chawanh heb' winh schekab' winhaj Is-boset chi', yajal yaj heb' winh t'a jun nhilanh heb' soldado elk'um. Ay jun winh skuch Baana, haxo junxo winh skuch Recab. Ha winhaj Rimón kajan t'a Beerot t'a slak'anil b'aj tz'ek' smakb'en heb' yik Benjamín ay yuninal heb' winh. (Ha heb' yinhtilal heb' anima kajan t'a Beerot chi', yinhtilal heb' winhaj Benjamín.
Anhejto b'atnakkan heb' t'a Gitaim, tonhej komon ayek' heb' ta', icha ch'ok chonhab'il yaj heb'.)

(Ha winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Saúl ay jun yuninal winh kannak skuch Mefi-boset. Ha jun winh chi', manh wach'ok yok winh schab'il, yujto ayik oye'anto ab'il sk'inal winh, ix jawi yab'ixal tas ix uji t'a Jezreel to toxo ix cham winhaj Saúl yet' winhaj Jonatán. Yuj chi' ix cheljib'at winh yuj jun ix tz'ilan k'ib'ok, ix b'at heb' elelal yalani. Yujto ix spil yip ix yeli, ix yaktanel winh ix, yuj chi' icha chi' ix aj yixtaxkan yok winh chi'.)
Haxo ix aji to ha winhaj Recab yet' winhaj Baana chi', ix b'at heb' winh t'a spat winhaj Is-boset ayik te ow k'ak' t'a chimk'uhalil. Waynak winh t'a sch'at yik syik' jab'ok yip.

Haxo ix stanhwumal spuerta'il spat winh, wan schaywi trigo ix, ix wayb'at ix. Wal t'a jun rato chi', ix och lemnaj winhaj Recab yet' winh yuk'tak chi' b'aj waynak winhaj Is-boset chi', malaj junok mach ix hilani.

Ayik ix och heb' winh t'a yol pat chi', ix yilan heb' winh to jichanek' winhaj Is-boset chi' sway t'a sch'at. Yuj chi' ix stekcham winh heb' winh, ix xikanel sjolom winh heb' winh, ix yik'anb'at heb' winh yet'ok. Pilan ak'wal ix b'ey heb' winh b'aj sb'at sb'e'al Arabá

yik sb'at yak'an heb' winh t'a winhaj rey David t'a Hebrón. Ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, ix kik'kot sjolom winhaj Is-boset yuninal winhaj Saúl, winh ochnak ajk'olal t'ayach, snib'ejnak winh hach smilchamok. Palta ha tikne'ik ix el t'a sk'o'ol Jehová yik tza pakan ha b'a t'a winhaj Saúl yet' t'a yinhtilal, xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj rey David chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Syil Jehová, haton ix hin kolanel t'a masanil tas ay smay ix ja t'a wib'anh

to ayik ix jawi jun winh winak t'a Siclag yik ix yik'ankot wach' ab'ix winh t'ayin yalani, yuj schamel winhaj Saúl, ix wak'an yamjok winh, ix wak'an miljokcham winh. Haton spak chi' ix wak' t'a winh yuj jun wach' ab'ix ix yik'kot chi' t'ayin.

Okxom wal t'ayex ha hex tik, smoj ton wal swak' spak t'ayex, yujto ix he milcham winh winak malaj smul yakb'an waynak winh t'a spat. Yuj chi' ol hex hin satel t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Manhxa b'ak'inh ol hex b'inaj jab'ok, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekan winh rey chi' miljicham heb' winh. Ix xikji'el sk'ab' heb' winh yet' yok yuj heb' soldado, ix k'e lokan sniwanil heb' winh b'aj ay yet'tal ha ha' t'a Hebrón chi'. Haxo sjolom winhaj Is-boset chi', ix yik'b'at heb' soldado, ix smukan heb' b'aj mukan winhaj Abner, t'a Hebrón chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix jawi masanil heb' yinhtilal Israel t'a winhaj David t'a Hebrón. Ix yalan heb' t'a winh icha tik: Ha honh tik te ayto ku'uj ko b'a het'ok.
T'a yalanhtaxo ayik ayto'och winhaj Saúl ko reyalok, ha hach honh ha kuchb'ejnak t'a owal. Hanheja' pax Jehová alannak t'ayach to ha hach ol honh ha kuchb'ej yet' och ko reyalok, xchi heb'.

Yakb'an ayek' heb' ta', haxo heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel ix lolon yet' winhaj David chi' yik sb'o'ankan strato winh yet' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'jikank'e aceite t'a sjolom winh yik sik'jikanoch winh sreyalok masanil heb' israel.
Ayik ix scha'anel yich winh yak'an reyal, 30 ab'il sk'inal winh. 40 ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh.
Nanhal swajxakil ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a yib'anh heb' aj Judá t'a Hebrón. Ixlajwi chi', 33 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a masanil heb' israel yet' t'a heb' aj Judá t'a Jerusalén.

Ay jun k'u ix b'at winhaj rey David chi' yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb' jebuseo ay t'a Jerusalén. Ix sna' heb' jebuseo chi' to max yal-laj yoch winhaj David chi' t'a yol schonhab' heb' chi', yuj chi' ix yal heb' t'a winh icha tik: k'okb'ilnhej heb' max uji yilani yet' heb' tz'em sb'eyi, ha heb' max hach cha'an ochta t'a tik, xchi heb'.
Wach'chom icha chi' ix yal heb', palta ix yak' ganar chonhab' Sion winh rey chi', yuj chi' schonhab' winhaj David ix sb'i'ejkani.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix yal winhaj David t'a heb' soldado: Ha mach sb'ab'lajoch yak' owal yet' heb' jebuseo tik, ochokab' t'a sb'e ha ha' tz'ochk'och t'a yol chonhab' chi', smilancham masanil heb' max uji yilan yet' heb' tz'em sb'eyi. Ha wal juntzanh heb' chi', tzin yaj heb', xchi winh. Hata' elnakkankot jun lolonel tz'alji: Ha heb' max uji yilani yet' heb' tz'em sb'eyi, max yal-laj yoch heb' t'a yol spalacio winh rey, xchi.

Ixlajwi chi', ix kajnaj winhaj David chi' t'a cuartel ay t'a jun chonhab' chi', ix yak'an skuch winh Schonhab' Winhaj David, ix laj sb'o'ank'e juntzanhxo pat winh t'a spatiktak, ix scha'el yich b'aj ix mukchaj jun ch'olan.
Ha Jehová Dios Yajal t'a Smasanil, ha ayoch yet' winhaj David chi', yuj chi' te niwan ix aj sb'inaj winh.

Ha winhaj Hiram sreyal Tiro, ix schekkot heb' smunlajwum winh t'a winhaj David, haton heb' nhikum te' yet' heb' mak'umpoj k'e'en, ix yik'anpaxkot te' k'ute' heb', yik sb'o'ank'e spat winhaj David chi' heb'.
Icha chi' ix aj snachajel yuj winhaj David chi' to ha Jehová ix ak'ankanoch winh reyal, yik te niwan tz'aj sb'inaj schonhab' Jehová chi', yujto te xajan yuj.
Ayik ix el winhaj David chi' t'a Hebrón, ix jawi winh t'a Jerusalén, ix kajnaj winh ta'. Ayto juntzanhxo heb' ix ix, ix yik' winh, yuj chi' tzijtumto yal yuninal winh ix alji.

Ha heb' yuninal winh ix alji t'a Jerusalén chi', haton heb' tik: Winhaj Samúa, winhaj Sobab, winhaj Natán, winhaj Salomón, winhaj Ibhar, winhaj Elisúa, winhaj Nefeg, winhaj Jafía, winhaj Elisama, winhaj Eliada yet' winhaj Elifelet.

Ayik ix yab'an heb' filisteo to toxo ix och winhaj David sreyalok Israel, ix kot heb' masanil yak' owal yet' winh, palta ayik ix yab'an winh, ix em winh b'aj ay juntzanh k'e'en niwak tenam yik wach' syak' owal chi' winh.
Ha heb' filisteo chi' ix k'och heb' t'a spanhanil Refaim, ix sb'o'ank'e scampamento heb' ta'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj David chi' t'a Jehová icha tik: --¿Tzam yal wak'an owal yet' heb' filisteo chi'? ¿Ol am ak'och heb' t'a yol hin k'ab'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi Jehová chi': --Ixik, ak' owal yet' heb'. Ha hin ol wak'och heb' t'a yol ha k'ab', xchi t'a winh.

Ix k'och winh yet' heb' soldado b'aj ayek' heb' filisteo chi'. Hata' ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj winh. Yuj chi' ix yal winh: Ha Jehová ix jakanb'at jun b'e t'a wichanh t'a skal heb' wajk'o'ol tik, icha wal tz'aj sb'at nhepnaj junok ha' eluma', xchi winh. Yuj chi' Baal-perazim ix sb'i'ejkan jun lugar chi'.
Ayik ix el lemnaj heb' filisteo chi', ix laj yaktejkan sdiosal heb', haxo winhaj David chi' yet' heb' soldado ix ik'ankoti.
Ix jaxpax heb' filisteo chi' t'a spanhanil Refaim chi'.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ejxi winhaj David chi' t'a Jehová. Ix tak'wixi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Manh hach k'och t'a sat heb', palta to ha t'a spatiktak heb' ol hach kotok. Ha b'aj ay juntzanh te' bálsamo tzach koti.

Ayik ol ab'an sk'anh jun icha sk'anh yek' anima t'a skaltak sk'ab' te te' chi', elanhchamel tza yamoch ak'an owal yet' heb', yujto ha jun chi' sch'oxani to ha hin ol hin b'ab'laj hu'uj, yik ol hin satanel heb' filisteo chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj rey David chi' tas ix yal Jehová. Yuj chi' ix yak' ganar heb' filisteo chi' winh, ix el yich spechan heb' winh t'a Geba masanto t'a Gezer.
Ix smolb'anxi heb' soldado winhaj David, ha heb' te jelan t'a skal heb' israel, ay 30 mil heb'.
Ix b'at heb' t'a Baala t'a yol yik Judá yik b'at yik'ankot te' skaxa'il strato Jehová Dios heb', haton te kaxa b'aj sb'inaj Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton ayek' t'a yib'anh heb' querubín.

Ha t'a yol spat winhaj Abinadab ay t'a jun tzalan, hata' ayek' te kaxa chi'. Ha t'a yib'anh jun te' carreta ak'to, hata' ix yik'kot te' kaxa chi' heb'. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Abinadab, haton winhaj Uza yet' winhaj Ahío, ha heb' skuchb'an b'ey nok' wakax nherjinak te' carreta b'aj ayk'e te' kaxa chi', ha winhaj Ahío b'ab'el sb'at yuj te'.

Haxo winhaj David yet' masanil heb' chonhab', wal t'a smasanil sk'o'ol heb' ix b'itan t'a tzalajk'olal, ix k'e cheneljok heb' t'a yichanh Jehová wan yoch te' arpa yet' salterio, panderas, castañuelas yet' platillo.
Ayik ix jawi heb' yet' skaxa'il strato Dios t'a stek'lab' trigo winhaj Nacón, ijan ix telwi nok' wakax et'jinak te' carreta chi', yuj chi' haxo winhaj Uza chi' ix yaman te' kaxa chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal Jehová t'a winh, yujto ix syam te' kaxa chi' winh. Hata' ix chamkan winh t'a stz'ey te' chi'.
Ix kot yowal winhaj David chi' yujto ix cham winhaj Uza chi' yuj Jehová. Yuj chi' Pérez-uza ix sb'i'ejkan jun lugar chi' yuj winh. Hanheja' icha chi' tikne'ik.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix xiwkank'e winhaj rey David chi' t'a Jehová. Yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Wach' am maxtzak wik'b'at te' skaxa'il strato Jehová tik b'aj kajan hin, xchi winh.
Majxo yal-laj sk'o'ol winhaj David chi' ix yik'kot te' kaxa chi' t'a schonhab'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh to tz'ik'jib'at te' t'a spat winhaj Obed-edom aj Gat.
Oxe' ujal ix kan te' ta'. Ix yak'wal swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh winhaj Obed-edom chi' yet' heb' kajan yet' winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj rey David chi' to yuj te' skaxa'il strato Jehová, ix yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh winhaj Obed-edom chi' yet' heb' kajan yet' winh yet' masanil tastak ay t'a winh, yuj chi' ix b'at yik'anxikot te' winhaj David chi'. Yet' wal tzalajk'olalil ix yik'kot te' winh t'a yol schonhab'.
Ayik jay b'ekanto skot heb' et'jinak te' kaxa chi', ix yak'an jun nok' mam wakax winhaj David chi' yet' jun nok' kelem wakax b'ak'ech silab'il t'a Jehová.
Ayoch jun chaleka nab'a lino yik sacerdote yuj winhaj David chi', ix k'e chennaj winh yuj tzalajk'olal yet' smasanil sk'o'ol t'a yichanh Jehová.

Icha chi' ix sk'ulej winh yet' masanil chonhab' Israel. Niwan k'inh ix yutej heb' ayik ix yik'ankot te' skaxa'il trato chi' heb' t'a Jerusalén, tz'el yaw heb', spu'an k'e'en trompeta heb' t'a tzalajk'olal.

Ayik ix jawi te' skaxa'il trato chi' t'a schonhab' winhaj David chi', t'anhanelta ix Mical yisilkan winhaj Saúl t'a swentena. Ix yilan ix to ha winhaj David chi' sk'e chennaj winh t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj chi' ix chab'axk'e sk'o'ol ix t'a winh.

Haxo yik ix jawi te' skaxa'il trato chi' yuj heb', ix sb'o'anoch te' heb' t'a yol jun mantiado b'ob'il yuj winhaj David chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh to snhusjitz'a silab' yet' pax silab' yik junk'olal yet' Jehová.
Ayik ix lajwi yak'ji juntzanh silab' chi', ix yalan wach' lolonel winhaj David chi' t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel t'a sb'i Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil.

Ix yak'an junjun ixim pan winh yet' jab'jab' b'olb'il chib'ej yet' junjun kechanh takinh sat uwa t'a masanil heb' chonhab', haton t'a heb' winh winak yet' t'a heb' ix ix. Ixlajwi chi', ix laj pax heb' t'a spat.

Ayik ix pax winhaj rey David chi' t'a spat yik syalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh heb' kajan t'a spat chi', ix elta ix Mical chi' scha winh, ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik hach sreyal chonhab' Israel, te wach'xo wal ix utej ha ch'oxanel ha b'a b'i'an. Ix ha ch'oxk'ab'ejel ha b'a t'a sat heb' ix schekab' heb' winh etyajalil. Te k'ixwelal ix utej ha b'a icha junok komon anima, xchi ix t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Wal yel ix hin k'e chennaj yuj tzalajk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová, haton ix hin sik'anoch yajalilok schonhab' sk'exulok winh ha mam yet' pax sk'exulok heb' ha k'ab' ok. Yuj chi' ol hin k'enhej chennaj yuj tzalajk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová.
Syalpax hin wach' ik'anemta hin b'a, swach' el hin k'ixwelal icha tzal chi', palta ha heb' ix ix tzal chi', niwan ol hin ajelk'och t'a sat heb' ix, xchi winhaj David chi'.
Ha ix Mical chi', malaj junok yune' ix aljinak.
Ayik ix kanxonhej winhaj rey David chi' t'a spalacio. Ayik toxo ix yak'och junk'olal Jehová t'a skal heb' israel yet' heb' ajk'o'ol yajoch t'a heb',
ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Natán schekab' Jehová: --Tik tzila' to nab'a k'ute' ayoch t'a hin palacio tik, haxo pax te' skaxa'il strato Dios jun, ha t'a yol jun mantiado ayoch te', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Natán chi': --Ujokab' icha tas tza na'a, yujto ha Jehová aynhejoch het'ok, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Natán chi' icha tik:
Ixik, b'at al t'a winh hin chekab' winhaj David, tzalani to ha hin Jehová hin swal icha tik: Manhok hachlaj ol ha b'ok'e junok templo b'aj ol hin aj chi'.
Atax yik ix wik'anelta heb' he mam heyicham t'a Egipto masanto tikne'ik, malaj b'aj ix hin aj t'a yol junok pat, anhej t'a yoltak mantiado hin ek'i.

B'ajtaktil ix hin ek'nhej yet' heb' hin chonhab', malaj b'aj ix hin k'an t'a junok heb' ayoch yajalil chonhab' chi' wu'uj, tas yuj max sb'o junok hin kajnub' heb', nab'a k'ute' tz'och t'ay, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh rey chi'.
Tzalanpax t'a winh icha tik: Ha hin Jehová Yajal hin t'a Smasanil swala': Ha hin ix hach wik'el t'a tanhwoj kalnel, ix hach wak'anoch yajalok hin chonhab' Israel.
Yalnhej b'ajtil tzach ek'i ayinnhej och het'ok. Ix hin satel masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach, ol hach wak' b'inaj icha heb' niwak winak t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Hanhejtona' ix hin sik'elta jun lum tik b'aj tzex kajnajkan ha hex hin chonhab' hex tik. Ha tik ol hex kannhej kajan t'a jun'elnhej. Manhxa mach ol hex xib'tanok, manhxo ol hex tzuntzaj yuj heb' heyajk'o'ol icha ix hex yutej heb' t'a sb'ab'elal,
ayik ix wak'anoch heb' ix hex kuchb'ani. Ha hin ol hin satel masanil heb' heyajk'o'ol. Swak'anpax ojtakejeli to ol wak'nhejkan opisio t'a heb' inhtilal.
Ayik ol lajwok ek' ha k 'inal, ayik mukb'il hachxo, ol wak'och junok uninal reyal ha k'exulok, tek'tek' wal ol wutej yopisio chi'.
Ha' ol b'o'ank'e hin kajnub' b'aj ol hin b'inajok. Ol wak'annhejkan yopisio chi' t'a heb' yinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha hin ol hin och smamok, haxo ol och wuninalok. Tato ay b'aj ol och spitalil t'ayin, ol wak'och syahelal icha syutej junok mamab'il smak'an yuninal.
Palta manh jab'ok ol waktejkan hin xajanani, manh icha'ok wutejnak waktankan hin xajanan winhaj Saúl, wik'nakel winh t'a yopisio, yik hach och sk'exulok winh.
Ha hin ol wak'nhejkan opisio tik t'a heb' inhtilal t'a masanil tiempo, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh, xchi t'a winhaj Natán chi'.
Icha ix aj yalan Jehová, icha wal chi' ix aj yalan winhaj Natán t'a winhaj rey David chi'.

Yuj chi' ix och winhaj David chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, ix em k'ojan winh ix lesalwi winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová Wajalil, ¿tas wal jab'ok welk'och yet' heb' hin mam wicham, yuj chi' ix ak' jun niwan opisio tik t'ayin?
Mamin Jehová, tas wal waj ha hin tik t'ayach yuj chi' ix ala' tas ol aj yelk'och winhtilal t'a b'ak'inh. Ha tas tzutej ha b'a tik t'ayin, manh icha'ok chi' syutej sb'a heb' anima.
Mamin Jehová Wajalil, manhxa tas syal walan t'ayach. Ha hach tik ojtak tas yaj hin pensar ha hin ha chekab' hin tik.
Masanil juntzanh lolonel satub'tak tik, ha hach ix ak' wojtakejeli, icha tas ix el t'a ha k'o'ol.
Mamin Jehová, malaj junokxo mach lajan het'ok. Ha hachnhej toni, malaj junokxo Dios skab' spekal icha hach tik.

Ha pax ha chonhab' Israel tik jun, malaj junokxo chonhab' lajan yet'ok. Yujto haxonhej jun chonhab' tik t'a sat lum tik ix ha kolkanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol yik tz'ochkan ha chonhab'ok. Yet' ha poder yet' tastak satub'tak ha b'onak, ik'nakelta heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto, ha satannakel juntzanh chonhab' yet' sdiosal t'a yichanh heb' yik niwan tz'ajelk'och ha b'i.
Yujto ha hach ix honh ak'och ha chonhab'ok t'a jun'elnhej, yuj chi' ha hach ix hach ochkan ko Diosalok.
Mamin Jehová, ha tikne'ik jun, elokab'k'och tas ix al t'ayin ha hin ha chekab' hin tik yet' t'a masanil winhtilal. Ichokab' chi' tz'aj yelk'och tas ix ala',

yik wach' tzach b'inaj t'a masanil tiempo, yik ol yal heb' anima to ha hach Jehová Dios hach, Yajal hach t'a yib'anh Smasanil, ha hachton ko Diosal hach ha honh israel honh tik. Hanheja' icha chi' ol aj yochnhej winhtilal reyal t'a ichanh.
Mamin Jehová, Yajal hach t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal hach, ha hach wal tzak' wojtakejeli to ol ochkan winhtilal t'a yajalil. Yuj chi' tzin tek'b'ej hin b'a hin k'anan jun tik t'ayach.
Ha hach tik Mamin Jehová, Dios hach, ha tas tzala' yelnhej, yelxo wal te wach' tas ix ak' ha ti' ak'an t'ayin.

Elokab' t'a ha k'o'ol ak'an ha wach'k'olal t'a winhtilal yik stek'b'ejnhej sb'a heb' t'a ichanh. Mamin Jehová, ha hach ix alkan jun tik, yuj chi' ha yuj ha wach'k'olal, wach' ol ajkan winhtilal t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winh t'a Jehová chi'.
Ha winhaj rey David yet' heb' soldado ix yak' ganar heb' filisteo heb', yuj chi' ix kan heb' t'a yalanh smandar winh.

Ix ak'jipax ganar heb' moabita yuj winh. Ix schekanem latz'an heb' winh smasanil t'a sat lu'um, ix yechtan heb' winh yet' jun ch'anh ch'anh. Ha jantak mach skan t'a yol chab' ch'anhil, schami, haxo mach skan t'a yol yik yoxil ch'anhil jun, max chamlaj. Icha chi' ix aj skan heb' moabita chi' t'a yalanh smandar winhaj rey David chi'. Ix chekji yak' tumin heb' t'a junjun ab'il yuj winh.

Hanheja' winhaj rey David chi' ix ak'an ganar winhaj Hadad-ezer, ayik wan sb'at winh stok'xikanek' smakb'en b'aj ay ha' niwan Éufrates. Ha winhaj Hadad-ezer chi' yuninal winh winhaj Rehob sreyal Soba.

Ha winhaj rey David chi' ix yaman mil 700 heb' soldado winhaj Hadad-ezer chi', haton heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' 20 mil heb' sb'ey t'a yok. Ix yik'anb'at heb' winh t'a preso. Ix stzepan sch'anhal yok nok' chej et'jinak carruaje chi' winh, haxonhej nok' snheran 100 carruaje ix yaktejkan winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix jawi heb' sirio ay t'a yol yik Damasco yik skolwaj yet' winhaj Hadad-ezer chi', palta ix ak'jipax ganar heb' yuj winhaj rey David chi', 22 mil heb' ix cham yuj winh.

Elanhchamel ix yak'och heb' soldado winhaj rey David chi' t'a yol yik Damasco chi', icha chi' ix aj skan heb' sirio chi' t'a yalanh smandar winh. Ix chekji yak' tumin heb' t'a junjun ab'il. Ha Jehová ix och yet' winh, yuj chi' yalnhej b'aj ix b'at winh yak' owal, ix yak'nhej ganar winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anpaxkanek' juntzanh maklab' jul-lab' winhaj rey David chi' t'a heb' soldado winhaj Hadad-ezer chi', ayoch oro t'ay, ix yik'ankot winh t'a Jerusalén.
Hanhejtona' te niwan pax k'e'en bronce ix yik'kanek' winh t'a chonhab' Beta yet' t'a Berotai, haton juntzanh chonhab' chi' ay t'a yol smakb'en winhaj Hadad-ezer chi'.
Haxo pax winhaj Toi, sreyal Hamat, ayik ix yab'an winh tas ix aj slajwi'el masanil heb' soldado winhaj Hadad-ezer yuj winhaj David chi',

ix schekanb'at jun yuninal winh skuchan Joram t'a winh. Ix yak'anpaxb'at k'e'en plata winh, k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en bronce, yuj yak'an stzatzil sk'o'ol winhaj David chi' winh. Ix yalanpaxb'at wach' lolonel winh t'a winh yujto ix ak'ji ganar winhaj Hadad-ezer yuj winh, yujto yak'nak owal winhaj Toi chi' yet' winhaj Hadad-ezer chi'.
Ha masanil juntzanh k'e'en ix scha' winhaj David t'a winhaj Toi chi', ix yak'pax k'e'en winh t'a Jehová yet' k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata kotnak t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' yak'nak ganar winh:
Haton t'a Edom, t'a Moab, t'a heb' amonita, t'a heb' filisteo, t'a heb' amalecita yet' k'e'en ix yik'kanek' winh ayik ix yak'an owal winh yet' winhaj Hadad-ezer.
Ix te b'inaj wal winhaj rey David chi' sik'lab'il ayik ix meltzajxi winh t'a owal yet' heb' edomita, 18 mil heb' ix cham yuj winh t'a jun Spanhanil Atz'am Atz'am.

Elanhchamel ix yak'och heb' soldado winhaj David chi' stanhwej Edom. Masanil heb' aj Edom chi', ix kan heb' t'a yalanh smandar winh. Ha Jehová ix ochnhej yet' winh t'a owal chi', yuj chi' yalnhej b'ajtil sb'at winh yak' owal, syak'nhej ganar winh.
Ha winhaj David chi', ix yak' reyal winh t'a masanil heb' chonhab' israel t'a stojolal yet' t'a swach'ilal.
Ha heb' ix ak'an yajalil yet' winh, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia, yajal winh t'a heb' soldado smasanil, winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Ahilud, tz'ib'um yaj winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Winhaj Sadoc yuninal winhaj Ahitob yet' winhaj Ahimelec yuninal winhaj Abiatar, sat sacerdote yaj heb' winh. Haxo winhaj Seraías stz'ib'an yab'ixal tastak sk'ulej winh rey chi' t'a stzolal.

Haxo pax winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' soldado stanhwan winh rey chi', haton heb' cereteo yet' heb' peleteo, haxo heb' yuninal winhaj rey David chi', sat yajal yaj heb'.
Ix sk'anb'anek' winhaj rey David chi' tato ayto junokxo yinhtilal winhaj Saúl ixto kani, yik syak'an swach'k'olal winh t'ay yuj swach'k'olal winhaj Jonatán yak'nak t'a winh.

Ay jun winh schekab' winhaj Saúl skuch Siba, ix awtajkot winh t'a yichanh winhaj rey David chi'. Haxo yik ix jawi winh, ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Ha hach am tik tza kuch Siba? xchi winh t'a winh. --I', ha hin ton mamin rey, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Manhxa am wal junok yinhtilal winhaj Saúl ayek'i, yik tzin ch'ox hin wach'k'olal t'ay icha ix wutej wak'an hin ti' t'a yichanh Jehová? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Siba chi': --Aytokan jun winh yuninal winhaj Jonatán, chuklaj yok winh schab'il, xchi winh.
--¿B'ajtil ay winh? xchi winhaj David chi'. --Ha t'a spat winhaj Maquir yuninal winhaj Amiel t'a Lodebar, hata' ayek' winh, xchi winhaj Siba chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' to b'at ik'jikot winhaj Mefi-boset yuninal winhaj Jonatán chi' winh yixchikin winhaj Saúl chi'. Ayik ix jawi winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a sat lu'um. Ix yalan winhaj David chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Mefi-boset, xchi winh. --Tik ayin mamin rey, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj David chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Manh hach xiwok, wach' ol wutej hin b'a t'ayach yuj b'aj xajan yilnak hin winhaj Jonatán winh ha mam. Ol wak'xikan masanil lum slu'um winh ha mam icham aj Saúl t'ayach. Ol hach wanhej wet' t'a hin mexa, xchi winh.
Ix em nhojan winhaj Mefi-boset chi', ix yalan winh: --Mamin rey, ¿tas wal yuj tz'ok' ha k'o'ol t'ayin? Ha hin ha chekab' hin tik lajan hin icha junok nok' chamnak tz'i', xchi winh.

Ix awtajxi winhaj Siba yuj winh rey chi', haton winh schekab'kan winhaj Saúl, ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Tik wal swak'xikan masanil tastak yik winh ha patrón yet' yuninal t'a winh yixchikin winh tik.

Ha hach tik yet' masanil heb' uninal yet' masanil heb' ha chekab', ol hex munlaj t'a sat lum slu'um winh chi'. Masanil tas ol el t'a sat lu'um, tza molb'ej t'a yol junok spatil, yik wach' tz'och yopisio yuj heb' yuninal winhaj Mefi-boset tik, palta haxo winh jun, ol wanhej winh wet'ok, xchi winh rey chi' t'a winh. Olajunhwanh yuninal winhaj Siba chi', 20 heb' schekab' winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Siba chi' t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Masanil tas tza chek hin k'ulej tik, ol hin k'anab'ajej, xchi winh. Ha winhaj Mefi-boset chi', junjun k'u swa winh yet' winh rey chi', icha wal yuninal winh ix yutej winh.
Ay jun yuninal winhaj Mefi-boset chi' yuneto skuchan Micaía. Masanil mach ayek' t'a spat winhaj Siba chi', schekab' winhaj Mefi-boset chi' yaj heb'.
Ha winhaj Mefi-boset chi', chuklaj yok winh schab'il, ha t'a Jerusalén ayek' winh yujto hata' swa winh yet' winhaj rey David chi'.
Ayik toxo ix ek' jun pekti', ix cham winhaj Nahas, sreyal heb' amonita, haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Hanún ix ochkan reyal.

Ix sna' winhaj rey David chi' to yowalil sch'ox swach'k'olal winh t'a winhaj Hanún chi', yujto sch'oxnak swach'k'olal winh smam winh t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix schekb'at juntzanh schekab' winh t'a winhaj Hanún chi' yik syak'an sniwanil sk'o'ol winh yuj schamel smam chi'. Palta ayik ix k'och heb' chekab' t'a schonhab' heb' amonita chi',

ha heb' winh yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi', ix yal heb' winh t'a winhaj Hanún chi': Mamin rey, ¿tom tzak'och t'a ha k'o'ol to niwan yelk'och winh ha mam chi' t'a yol sat winhaj rey David chi', yuj chi' ix schekkot juntzanh winak tik winh yik syak' sniwanil ha k'o'ol heb'? Ma'ay. Ix chekjikot heb' yuj winh yik tzul yil heb' tas yaj ko chonhab' tik, yik tzul satanel heb', xchi heb' t'a winh.

Yuj chi', ix schekan winhaj Hanún chi' yamjok heb' schekab' winhaj rey David chi', ix joxji'el xil sti' heb' t'a jun pak'anh spak'ul sti', ix polji'el yoktak sti' spichul heb' masanto ix k'e'ul t'a sti' syo'op heb', ix lajwi chi' ix schekan pax heb' winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj rey David chi' tas ix aj heb', ix chekjib'at scha'umal heb' yuj winh, yujto te k'ixwelal ix utaj heb', ix alji t'a heb' to skan heb' t'a Jericó masanto sk'ib'xi xil sti' heb' chi', ichato chi' syal smeltzaj pax ta heb'.

Haxo heb' amonita chi', ix nachajel yuj heb' to chuk ix kan heb' t'a winhaj rey David chi', yuj chi' 20 mil heb' soldado yik Siria t'a yol yik Bet-rehob yet' t'a yol yik Soba ix stup heb'. Ix kotpax mil heb' soldado winh sreyal Maaca yet' 12 mil heb' soldado aj Is-tob.
Haxo ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj rey David chi', ix schekanb'at winhaj Joab winh yet' heb' soldado chi'.
Ix elta heb' amonita chi' t'a sti' schonhab', ix sb'o'anoch sb'a heb' t'a owal ta', haxo heb' soldado ix tupji yik skot yak' owal chi', najat ix sb'opaxem sb'a heb' t'a sti'el chonhab' chi'.

Ayik ix yilan winhaj Joab chi' to ay jun makan heb' soldado t'a yichanh winh, ay pax junxo makan heb' t'a spatik winh, ix sik'anel heb' soldado winh, haton heb' te jelan t'a owal, yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' sirio chi'.
Haxo juntzanhxo heb' soldado, ix yak'och winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Abisai winh yuk'tak winh, yik sb'at heb' yak' owal yet' heb' amonita chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' t'a winh yuk'tak chi' icha tik: Tato ha heb' sirio chi' wan hin yak'an ganar, tzach kot hin ha kolo'. Tato ha heb' amonita chi' wan hach yak'an ganar jun, ha hinxo ol hin b'at hach hin kolo'.
Kak' kip, ko tek'b'ej ko b'a yuj ko kolan ko chonhab' ha honh schonhab' honh ko Diosal tik. Elokab'k'och tas wach' snib'ej Jehová, xchi winhaj Joab chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Joab chi' yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb' sirio chi', haxo ix aji, ix el lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh winh.

Ayik ix yilan heb' amonita to toxo ix el lemnaj heb' sirio chi', ix elpax lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh winhaj Abisai, ix och heb' skol sb'a t'a yol schonhab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix och wa'an winhaj Joab chi' yak'an owal yet' heb' amonita chi', ix meltzajkot winh t'a Jerusalén.
Ayik ix yilan heb' sirio chi' to ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb' israel, ix smolb'anxi sb'a heb'.

Ix awtajkot heb' sirio chi' yuj winhaj rey Hadad-ezer, haton heb' ay t'a junxo sk'axepalek' ha' Éufrates, ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Helam. Ha winhaj Sobac b'ab'el t'a yichanh heb', haton winh yajal t'a heb' soldado yik winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi'.

Palta ix alchajpax juntzanh tik t'a winhaj rey David, yuj chi' ix smolb'ej masanil heb' soldado yik Israel winh, ix ek' heb' t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán, ix k'och heb' t'a Helam. Hata' ix stek'b'ej sb'a heb' sirio chi' yak'an owal yet' heb' israel chi'.

Haxo ix aji, ix el lemnaj heb' sirio chi' t'a yichanh winhaj rey David chi' yet' heb' israel. 40 mil soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' pax 700 heb' ayoch t'a yol carruaje ix smilcham heb' soldado yik Israel chi'. Ix champax winhaj Sobac yajalil heb' soldado sirio yuj heb'.

Ayik ix yilan masanil heb' rey ayoch yet' winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi' to toxo ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb' israel chi', ix yak'anoch sb'a heb' t'a junk'olal yet' heb' israel chi', yuj chi' ix kanxonhej heb' t'a yalanh smandar winhaj rey David chi'. Atax ta' ix xiwkank'e heb' sirio chi', majxo yak'xi'ochlaj sb'a heb' skolwaj yet' heb' amonita chi'.

Ha t'a junxo ab'il, t'a stiempo'al sb'at heb' rey t'a owal, ix chekjib'at winhaj Joab yuj winhaj rey David yet' masanil heb' yajalil heb' soldado yet' masanil heb' soldado israel t'a owal. Ix satanel heb' amonita heb', ix yoyan sb'a heb' t'a spatik chonhab' Rabá. Maj b'atlaj winh rey chi' yet' heb', ix kan winh t'a Jerusalén.

Ha t'a jun yemk'uhalil, ix k'e wa'an winhaj rey David chi' t'a sat sch'at, ix k'e winh matz'anel t'a spanhanil yib'anh spat. Ayik ayek' winh ta', ix yilanb'at jun ix ix winh, wan sb'ikan sb'a ix, te wach' yilji ix ix yil winh.
Elanhchamel ix schekb'at winh k'anb'ajek'ok mach jun ix ix chi', haxo ix alchaj t'a winh to ha ix Betsabé yisil winhaj Eliam, yetb'eyum winhaj Urías heteo.
Elanhchamel ix schekb'at schekab' winh yik b'at ik'jokkot ix, ix way winh yet' ix. Ixlajwi chi', ix sakb'itan sb'a ix, ix pax ix t'a spat.
Haxo ix aji, ix skuchkanoch yune' ix, yuj chi' elanhchamel ix yalb'at ix yab' winhaj rey David chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an winh icha chi', ix yalanb'at winh t'a winhaj Joab to spaxta winhaj Urías chi' t'a owal. Ix sk'anab'ajan winhaj Joab tas ix yal winh chi'.
Haxo ix jawi winhaj Urías sch'ox sb'a t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix sk'anb'an winh tato wach' sk'o'ol winhaj Joab yet' heb' soldado, chajtil pax yak'an owal.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Urías chi' icha tik: Ixik, b'at ik' ip, tzach way t'a ha pat, xchi winh t'a winh. Ixnhej wal elta winh t'a yol spalacio winh rey chi', ix b'at ak'jikan swa'el winh, te wach' icha swa'el winh rey.
Palta maj b'atlaj winh t'a spat chi'. Ix waykan winh yet' heb' soldado stanhwan palacio chi'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix alji t'a winh rey chi' to maj b'at waylaj winhaj Urías chi' t'a spat t'a jun ak'wal chi'. Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winh rey chi' t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj maj xit' hach way t'a ha pat, ina to ayxotax ha b'atkani? xchi winh rey chi' t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winh: --Max yal-laj hin komon b'at t'a hin pat yik tzin wa'i, tzin waypax yet' ix wetb'eyum yakb'an ha te' skaxa'il strato Jehová yet' heb' wetsoldado'al yik Israel yet' heb' yik Judá, ha te' xiltak te' ayk'e t'a yib'anh heb', icha pax chi' winh wajalil winhaj Joab yet' heb' yetyajalil, ha t'a ak'lik b'aj sway heb'. Mamin rey, max yal-laj hin k'o'ol to wach' b'aj ol hin wayok, xchi winhaj Urías chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj David chi' t'a winh: --Kananh t'a junxo ak'wal tik, haxo k'ik'an tzach b'ati, xchi winh t'a winh. Ichato chi' ix kan winhaj Urías chi' t'a junxo ak'wal chi' t'a Jerusalén.

Ix yawtej winh winh rey chi' wa'el yet'ok, ix yak'an wino winh yuk'ej winh. Ix k'e t'a sjolom winhaj Urías chi', palta manh yujok chi' ix b'at winh wayanh t'a spat chi', hata' ix wayxikan winh yet' heb' soldado jun'elxo.
Haxo ix k'inhib'i t'a junxo k'u, ix stz'ib'anb'at jun carta winhaj rey David chi' t'a winhaj Joab, ix schekan winh yik'b'at ch'anh winhaj Urías chi'.
Ix yalanb'at winh t'a ch'anh icha tik: Tzak'och winhaj Urías tik t'a yichanh b'aj te ow yak'an owal, tzex el t'a stz'ey winh yik wach' scham winh, xchib'at winh.
Yuj chi', ayik ix yoyan sb'a winhaj Joab chi' yet' heb' soldado t'a spatik jun chonhab' chi', ha b'aj ayek' heb' ajk'o'ol te jelan, hata' ix ak'ji'och winhaj Urías chi' yuj winhaj Joab chi'.

Haxo yik ix elta heb' ajk'o'ol chi' t'a yol schonhab', ix yak'an owal heb' yet' heb' soldado winhaj Joab chi'. Ay jaywanh heb' soldado winhaj David chi' ix chami, ha t'a skal heb' ix cham winhaj Urías chi'.
Ix yak'ankot jun winh schekab' winhaj Joab chi' t'a winhaj rey David yik syalani chajtil ix aj yoch owal chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a winh schekab' chi': Ayik slajwi halan t'a winh rey tas ix aj yoch owal tik,
talaj skot yowal winh, syalan winh: ¿Tas yuj ix hex te och t'a tz'ey jun chonhab' chi'? ¿Tom manh heyojtakok to ha heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh muro syal yaktanemta junok tas heb' t'a heyib'anh?

¿Tom manh heyojtakok yab'ixal jun ix ix t'a Tebes, ix yaktejemta jun k'e'en k'e'en yik molino ix t'a sjolom winhaj Abimelec yuninal winhaj Jerobaal? ¿Tas yuj ix he te nitzejoch he b'a? ta xchi winh, tzalani to ix champax winhaj Urías heteo, xchi winhaj Joab chi'.
Ix kot jun winh chekab' chi', ix jawi winh t'a yichanh winhaj rey David chi', ix yalan winh masanil tas ix yalkot winhaj Joab chi'.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Te ow ix aj yelta heb' ajk'o'ol chi' t'ayonh. Ijan wal ix honh yak' ganar heb', palta ix ko tek'b'ej ko b'a ko pechan meltzaj heb', masanto ix ochxikan heb' t'a yol schonhab' chi'.
Ha t'a yib'anh muro ix julwajkot heb' winh ajk'o'ol chi' t'a heb' ha chekab', yuj chi' ix cham jaywanh heb' winh soldado, ix champax winhaj Urías heteo, xchi jun winh chekab' chi'.

Ix yalan winh rey t'a jun winh chekab' chi': --Al t'a winhaj Joab chi' to max kuslaj winh yuj jun chi'. Toxonton icha chi' t'a owal tik, ay mach schami. Yak'okab' yip winh yak'an owal t'a jun chonhab' chi', masanto syal satel heb' anima chi' yuj winh, xa chi t'a winh. Icha chi' tz'aj iptzitan winhaj Joab chi', xchi winhaj rey David chi' t'a jun winh chekab' chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an ix yetb'eyum winhaj Urías to toxo ix cham winh yetb'eyum ix chi', ix och ix t'a kusk'olal yuj winh.

Ayik ix lajwi yek' skusk'olal ix, icha sb'eyb'al heb', ix b'at chekchaj ik'jikot ix t'a spat yuj winhaj rey David chi', ix och ix yetb'eyumok winh. Ix alji jun yune' ix. Palta ha jun tas ix sk'ulej winh chi', maj schalaj sk'o'ol Jehová.

Haxo Jehová ix chekankot winhaj Natán t'a winhaj David chi'. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan jun ab'ix tik winh t'a winh: --Ha t'a jun chonhab', ay chawanh heb' winh winak: Ay jun winh te b'eyum, ay pax junxo winh te meb'a'.
Ha winh b'eyum chi', te ay nok' skalnel winh yet' nok' swakax.

Haxo pax winh meb'a' chi' jun, junnhej pitanh tzun skalnel winh manb'il yuj. Ha' winh ix k'ib'tzitan nok'. Ha t'a yol spat winh ix k'ib' nok' yet' heb' yuninal. Ha tas swa winh, tas yuk' winh, ha chi' swa nok', syuk' nok'. Schelway nok' winh, te xajan nok' yuj winh. Ichato yisil nok' winh.

Ay jun k'u, ay jun winh tonhej sb'eyek'i, ix ek' winh yak' spaxyal winh b'eyum chi'. Ha winh b'eyum chi', maj syamlaj junok nok' skalnel winh, ma junok nok' swakax winh yik syak'an schi winh paxyalwum chi', te ya yel nok' yuj winh. Haxo jun pitanh nok' yik winh meb'a' chi' ix b'at yak' ik'jokkot winh. Ha nok' ix yak' winh schi jun winh paxyalwum chi', xchi winhaj Natán chi' t'a winhaj rey David chi'.
Ix kot wal yowal winhaj rey David chi', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Natán chi': --T'a yichanh Jehová Dios swala', ha jun winh icha chi' ix sk'ulej, smoj wal scham winh.
Yowalil syak' chanhwanhok nok' winh sk'exulok nok' yune' kalnel chi', yujto ha jun winh winak chi' malaj wal jab'ok yok'elk'olal winh t'a yetanima'il, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Natán chi': --Ha jun winh chi', ha hach toni. Icha tik yalan Jehová ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik t'ayach: Ha hin ix hach hin sik'och sreyalok Israel, ix hach hin kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Saúl.
Ix wak' spat yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum winh ajalil chi' t'ayach, ix hach wak'anoch sreyalok chonhab' Israel yet' Judá. Tato jab'nhej juntzanh chi' tzab'i, tzato yal wak'an nanhalokxo t'ayach.
¿Tas yuj ix ha patikejel hin cheknab'il, ix ha k'ulej tas to max scha hin k'o'ol? Ix ha milcham winhaj Urías heteo yet' k'e'en yespada heb' amonita. Ix ik'ankan ix yetb'eyum winh chi'.
Yuj chi' aynhej mach ol miljokcham t'a skal inhtilal, yujto ix hin ha patikejeli, ix ik'ankan ix yetb'eyum winhaj Urías heteo.

Ha hin Jehová hin swala': Ol wak'och yahelal t'a ib'anh. Ha yahelal chi', ha t'a skal heb' uninal ol elta, t'a wal ichanh ol wik'elta heb' ix etb'eyum, ol wak'an heb' ix t'a junok winh uninal, ol way winh yet' heb' ix t'a k'uhalil t'a yichanh anima.
Ha hach tik, elk'altak ix ha k'ulej, ha hinxo tik, t'a wal sakil k'inal t'a k'uhalil ol hin ch'oxel t'a yichanh chonhab' Israel, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Natán chi'.

Ix scha'an smulok winhaj rey David t'a yichanh winhaj Natán chi', ix yalan winh: --T'a wal yel, ix och hin mul t'a Jehová, xchi winh. Ix yalanpax winhaj Natán chi': --Yel ton tzala', palta ix ak'ji lajwok ha mul chi' yuj Jehová, yuj chi' manhxo ol hach chamlaj.
Palta ha yuj tas ix ha k'ulej chi', tz'alji chukal lolonel t'a Jehová yuj heb' ajk'o'ol yajoch t'ay, yuj chi' ol cham jun uninal toto ix alji chi', xchi winhaj Natán chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix pax winhaj Natán chi' t'a spat. Haxo Jehová, ix ak'anoch syahelal jun yuninal winhaj David chi' yet' ix yetb'eyumkan winhaj Urías chi'.
Yuj chi', ix och ijan winh sk'anan t'a Jehová to sb'oxi sk'o'ol winh unin chi'. Ix och winh t'a tzek'ojk'olal, ix kannhej telan winh t'a sat lu'um t'a junjun ak'wal.

Ha jantak heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' smunlaj yet' winh, tz'och ijan heb' winh stewi to sk'e wa'an winh t'a sat lum chi', palta maxtzak yal-laj sk'o'ol winh, max b'at walaj winh yet' heb' winh.

Haxo t'a yukil k'uhal syamchaj winh unin chi' yuj ilya chi', ix chami. Ix te xiw heb' winh smunlajum winh rey chi' yalan t'ay, yujto sna heb': Ina ayik pitzanto winh unin chi', maj scha yab' winh tas ix kala', okxom wal tikne'ik. Tato skal t'a winh to toxo ix chami, tas am ol sk'ulok winh, xchi heb' winh.

Ix yab'an winhaj rey David chi' ayik sajson heb' winh sloloni, ix sna'anel winh to toxo ix cham winh unin chi', yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winh: --¿Tom toxo ix chami? xchi winh. --Toxo ix cham mamin rey, xchi heb' winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winh icha chi', ix k'e wa'an winh t'a sat lu'um chi', ix sb'ikanel sb'a winh, ix yak'ank'e yanhal xil sjolom winh, ix sk'exanel spichul winh, ix och winh ejmelal t'a yol skajnub' Jehová. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at sk'anan wa sb'a winh t'a yol spat.

Ix sk'anb'an heb' winh smunlajwum winh chi' t'ay: --Mamin rey, ¿tas wal yuj icha tik tza k'ulej? Ayik pitzanto jun uninal chi', manh jab'ok syal ha k'o'ol tzach wa'i, tzach ok' yuj. Haxo tikne'ik toxo ix chami, tzach k'e wa'an, tzach wa'i, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' winh: --Ayik pitzanto winh unin chi', tzin och t'a tzek'ojk'olal, tzin ok'i, ha hin na'ani talaj tzato ok' sk'o'ol Jehová t'ayin.
Haxo pax tikne'ik, ¿tasto wal yuj tzin och t'a tzek'ojk'olal? ¿Tom olto pitzwok winh? Manhxa b'ak'inh ol jax winh t'ayin, anhej to ha hin ol hin b'at b'aj ix k'och winh chi', xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an sniwanil sk'o'ol ix Betsabé winhaj David chi', ix way winh yet' ix, ix skuchanoch yune' ix. Ix alji junxo yune' ix, Salomón ix yak' ix b'i'ej. Te xajan ix aj jun unin chi' yuj Jehová.
Ix schekanb'at winhaj Natán Jehová yal t'a winhaj rey David chi' to xajan jun unin chi' yuj. Yuj chi' Jedidías ix sb'i'ej jun unin chi' yuj Jehová.
Yakb'an chi', ha winhaj Joab ix ak'an owal yet' heb' amonita t'a Rabá. Ayik wanxo yak'an ganar winh yoch t'a yol jun chonhab' chi',
ix yalankot winh t'a winhaj rey David chi' icha tik: Wanxo woch t'a yol chonhab' Rabá. Ha jun cuartel b'aj ay heb' stanhwan ha ha' sk'anchaj t'a chonhab' tik, ayxo och t'a yol hin k'ab'.

Yuj chi', mamin rey, molb'ej masanil heb' soldado aykan het'ok, tzach kot yet' heb' ak' owal t'a jun chonhab' tik yik tzak'an ganar. K'inalok ha hin swak' ganar jun chonhab' tik, ha hin am tzin b'inajkan t'ay, xchikot winhaj Joab chi'.
Ix smolb'an masanil heb' soldado winh rey chi', ix b'at winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Rabá chi'. Ix yak'an ganar winh yik'ankani.

Ix yik'anek' scorona winh sreyal heb' amonita chi' winh. Ix yak'ank'e heb' t'a sjolom winh. Ay jun k'e'en k'e'en te caro stojol ayoch t'ay. Ha jun corona chi', te al, ay am oxe'ok arroba yalil. Tzijtumto pax tastak te ay stojol ix yik'ek' winhaj David chi' t'a jun chonhab' chi'.

Haxo heb' anima ixto kani, ix ik'ji'elta heb' yuj winh, ix ak'ji'och heb' t'a munlajel ya, icha t'a k'e'en sierra, k'e'en pi'ocha yet' pax k'e'en ch'akab'. Ix ak'jipaxoch heb' t'a mukoj ladrillo t'a horno. Hanheja' icha pax chi' ix aj masanil heb' ay t'a juntzanhxo schonhab' heb' amonita yuj winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzaj winh yet' masanil heb' soldado t'a Jerusalén.

Ha winhaj Absalón yuninal winhaj rey David, ay jun ix yanab' winh skuch Tamar, te wach' yilji ix. Haxo ix aji, ha winhaj Amnón yuninal pax winhaj rey David chi', ix te kan snib'ej winh t'a ix Tamar schab'il yanab', yuj chi' ix te chukb'i sk'o'ol winh yuj sna'ub'tanhan ix. Te ayoch yilumal ix yujto kob'esto ix, yuj chi' ix sna winhaj Amnón chi' to ajaltak sk'uman ix winh.
Palta ay jun winh yamigo winh skuchan Jonadab, yuninal winhaj Simea yuk'tak winhaj David chi', te jelan winh t'a chukal.

Ay jun k'u ix sk'anb'ej winh t'a winhaj Amnón chi': --Hach yuninal rey, ¿tas tzach ik'ani? ¿Tas yuj junjun k'u tzach te tz'onb'i yuj kusk'olal? Al t'ayin tas tzach ik'ani, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Amnón chi': --Ste kan wal hin gana t'a ix Tamar, yanab' winh schab'il wuk'tak aj Absalón, xchi winh.

Haxo ix yalan winhaj Jonadab chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik, ek'anh jichan t'a ha ch'at, tza tz'akan pena'ayax ha b'a. Ayik ol jawok winh ha mam hach yila', tzal t'a winh icha tik: Tzin tewi t'ayach to tza chekkot ix Tamar ix wanab', yik syak' jab'ok hin wa'el ix, a'okab' ix sb'o'ani, yik wach' ol wila', ol hin wa'ani, ol hin cha'an t'a ix, xa chi t'a winh, xchi winh.

Ix ek' jichan winhaj Amnón chi' t'a sch'at, ix stz'akan pena'ayax sb'a winh. Ayik ix k'och winh rey chi' yil winh, ix yal winh icha tik: --Tzin tewi t'ayach to skot ix wanab' Tamar t'a tik, sb'o'an chab'ok hin pan ix, tzul yak'ankan ix t'ayin, xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix chekjib'at ix yuj winhaj rey David chi', ix yalan winh t'a ix: --Ixik t'a spat winhaj Amnón ha nulej, b'at ha b'o'an jab'ok tas swa winh, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at ix Tamar t'a spat winh snulej chi', haxo ix k'och ix, jichan ek' winh. K'elanoch winh t'a ix, ix sb'o'an ixim pan chi' ix.

Ix yak'an k'anb'ok ixim ix t'a yol xalten, ix yik'anelta ix t'a yol xalten chi', palta haxo winhaj Amnón chi' maj yal-laj sk'o'ol winh ix wa'i, ix yalan winh: Elanhek t'a tik he masanil, xchi winh. Ix elta heb', manhxalaj junok mach ix kani.

Ayik toxo ix elta heb' chi' smasanil t'a patik pat chi', ix yalan winh t'a ix Tamar chi' icha tik: --Ik'kot hin wa'el chi' b'aj tzin way tik, xchi winh t'a ix. Ix yik'anb'at ixim pan chi' ix t'a winh snulej chi' t'a sch'at.
Haxo yik ix k'och ix t'a stz'ey winh yet' swa'el chi', ix och lak'naj winh t'a ix, ix yalan winh: --Kotanh hach wanab', wayanh wet'ok, xchi winh t'a ix.
Ix tak'wi ix t'a winh: --Ma'ay hach hin nulej, manh hin ak' pural, yujto ha jun tik manh smojok yuji t'a ko kal ha honh israel honh tik, te k'ixwelal ol aj jun tik.

Nato nab'i ¿tas ol hin k'ulej yuj jun hin k'ixwelal tik? Hanhejtona' ha hach tik icha junok kistal ol hach ajkan t'a skal ko chonhab' tik. Ha tikne'ik, swal t'ayach to tzal t'a winh rey, ha winh ol hin ak'an t'ayach etb'eyumok, xchi ix.
Palta majxo schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal ix chi'. Yujto te ay yip winh t'a yichanh ix, yuj chi' ix yak'an pural ix winh yixtani.

Ayik ix lajwi yixtan ix winh, te chuklaj ix aj yilanoch ix winh, t'a yichanh ix aj skan snib'ej winh t'a ix t'a sb'ab'elal, yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a ix icha tik: --K'e'anh wa'an, elanh t'a tik t'a elanhchamel, xchi winh t'a ix.
Palta ix tak'wi ix: --Ma'ay hach hin nulej, tato tzin ha pechel t'a tik tikne'ik, yelxo te chuk t'a yichanh tas ix hin utej tik, xchi ix. Palta majxo schalaj yab' winh.
Haxo ix aji, ix yawtankot winh schekab' winh, ix yalan winh: --Pechel jun ix ix tik t'a tik, wach' tzutej ha makan te' pat chi', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix pechji'elta ix yuj winh schekab' winh chi', wach' ix yutej winh smakan sti' te' pat chi'. Ha ix Tamar chi', ayoch jun spichul ix te wach' yuj, haton syak'och heb' ix kob'estak yisil rey.
Ix yak'ank'e k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh ix t'a sjolom, ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul ix ayoch yuj, ix yak'anoch sk'ab' ix t'a sat, te cha'anh ix ok' ix sb'at t'a yoltak b'e.

Ix sk'anb'an winh snulej ix skuchan Absalón t'ay: --¿Tom hach yixtej winh ha nulej aj Amnón chi'? Tato icha chi' hach wanab', emanh numan b'ela. Mokab' hach te ok' yuj ilk'olal yuj jun chi', yujto ha nulej winh, xchi winh t'a ix. Yuj chi' ix kan ix t'a spat winh snulej chi'. Te kusk'olal ix ajkan ix.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj rey David masanil tas ix uji chi', ix kot wal yowal winh sik'lab'il.
Haxo winhaj Absalón chi', malaj tas ix yal winh t'a winhaj Amnón chi', wach'chom ste chichon sk'o'ol winh t'a winh yuj b'aj ix ixtaj ix yanab' chi'.

Schab'ilxo ab'il chi', ha heb' winh schekab' winhaj Absalón chi', sjoxwi kalnel heb' winh t'a Baal-hazor, t'a slak'anil schonhab' heb' aj Efraín. Ix yawtan masanil heb' winh yuninal winh rey chi' winhaj Absalón chi' t'a jun niwan wa'el.

Ix b'at yalan winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, ha tikne'ik ha heb' winh hin chekab' wan sjoxan nok' hin kalnel heb' winh. Tzin nib'ej, tzach b'at wet'ok yet' masanil heb' etyajalil, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ma'ay hach wuninal, max yal-laj ko b'at ko masanil het'ok. Tekan niwan tas b'at ko lajeli, xchi winh. Ix och wal te'an winhaj Absalón chi' t'a winh, palta maj yal-laj sk'o'ol winh ix b'ati, anhej wach' lolonel ix yal winh t'a winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Absalón chi': --Tato wal yel max yal-laj ha b'ati, elokab' t'a ha k'o'ol ha cha'anb'at winh wuk'tak aj Amnón wet'ok, xchi winh. --¿Tas yuj tza nib'ej sb'at winh uk'tak aj Amnón chi' het'ok? xchi winhaj rey David chi' t'a winh.
Ix och wal te'an winhaj Absalón chi' t'a winh, yuj chi' ix schekb'at winhaj Amnón chi' winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh yuk'tak.

Ayik mantzak ochlaj wa'el chi', ix yalan winhaj Absalón chi' t'a heb' winh schekab': Scham wal heyilani ayik toxo ix k'e anh t'a sjolom winhaj Amnón chi', ol walan t'ayex to tze milcham winh. Manh hex xiwok, yujto ha hin swala', yuj chi' tze tek'b'ej he b'a he milancham winh, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anab'ajej heb' winh tas ix yal winh, ix smilcham winhaj Amnón chi' heb' winh. Ayik ix yilan masanil heb' winh yuninal winh rey chi', ix k'e somnaj heb' winh, ix laj k'e heb' winh t'a yib'anh nok' smula, ix b'at heb' winh elelal.
Ayik ayto och heb' winh t'a yol b'e, ix k'och spekal t'a winhaj rey David to toxo ix cham masanil heb' yuninal winh yuj winhaj Absalón, manhxo junok heb' winh ixto kani.

Yuj chi' ix k'e juknaj winh, ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh, ix sjulanek' telan sb'a winh t'a sat lu'um yuj kusk'olal. Haxo masanil heb' yetyajalil winh ayek' yet'ok, ix snhik'chitejpaxb'at spichul heb'.

Palta ha winhaj Jonadab yuninal winhaj Simea, yuk'tak winhaj rey David chi', ix yal winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, manh ha na' icha chi'. Maj chamlaj heb' winh uninal chi' smasanil, anhej winhaj Amnón ix chami, yujto icha chi' ix aj sna'an winhaj Absalón t'a spatik winh, yiktax ix yixtan ix Tamar winh.
Yuj chi' manh ha na' to masanil heb' winh uninal ix chami, palta anhej winhaj Amnón ix chami, xchi winh.

Yakb'an chi' ix b'at winhaj Absalón chi' elelal. Ay jun winh kelem ayk'e t'a yib'anh smuro'al chonhab' chi' yik smaklani, ix k'e k'elnaj winh, ix yilan winh to ay juntzanh anima tz'emta t'a pak'an t'a sat witz t'a sb'e'al Horonaim, yuj chi' ix yalb'at winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Jonadab t'a winh rey chi': --Mamin rey, wan sjawi heb' winh uninal icha ix aj walan ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, xchi winh.
Hato wal slajwi yalan winhaj Jonadab chi' ix k'och heb' winh yuninal winh rey chi'. Ayik ix k'och heb' winh, ix k'e sjaj heb' winh yok'i, ix te ok'pax winh rey chi' yet' heb' yetyajalil.

Haxo winhaj Absalón chi', ix b'atkan winh elelal. Ha t'a winhaj Talmai yuninal winhaj Amiud sreyal Gesur ix k'ochkan winh. Oxe' ab'il ix kan winh ta'. Haxo pax winhaj rey David chi', junjun k'u ix ok' winh yuj schamel winh yuninal.
Ayik toxo ix ek'b'at skusk'olal winh chi' jun, snib'ej winh sb'at yil winhaj Absalón chi'.
Ha winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia yojtak winh to ste kus winh rey yuj winhaj Absalón.

Yuj chi' ix b'at schek winh ik'jokkot jun ix ix te jelan spensar kajan t'a Tecoa. Ix yalan winh t'a ix icha tik: Tz'ak kus wal ha b'a, tzak'anoch pichul yik kusk'olal. Manh ak'och perfume t'ayach. Icha wal junok ix ix to ayxo syamanoch yok' yuj junok chamnak, icha chi' tzutej ha b'a.
Slajwi chi' ol halan t'a yichanh winh rey tas ol wal tik t'ayach, xchi winh t'a ix. Ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' tas ol yutok ix yalani.
Ix b'at ix t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix em nhojan ix t'a sat lu'um yuj sch'oxanel yemnakilal ix t'a winh, ix yalan ix: --Mamin rey, kolwajanh wet'ok, xchi ix.
--¿Tas tzach ik'ani? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi ix: --Mamin rey, ha hin tik chamnakxo winh wetb'eyum.
Anhej chawanh wune' ay. Ay jun'el ix yak' owal heb' winh t'a kaltak te'. Yujto malaj mach ix pojan heb' winh, yuj chi' ay jun winh ix miljicham yuj winh yuk'tak chi'.

Haxo tikne'ik masanil heb' hin k'ab' wok smeltzajoch ajk'olal t'ayin, snib'ej heb' swak'och winh ix milancham winh yuk'tak chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yik smilancham winh heb' yuj schamel winh yuk'tak chi'. Icha chi' snib'ej heb' yik satkanel winh ay yalan yik yik'ankan smakb'en smam chi'. Tato icha chi', manhxa mach swak'och yipok hin k'o'ol, tzam satel masanil yinhtilal winh wetb'eyum, manhxa am b'aj sb'inajkan winh, xchi ix.
Ix tak'wi winh rey chi' t'a ix icha tik: --Paxanh t'a ha pat, ol xo wila' tas ol wutej hin kolwaj t'ayach, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix t'a winh icha tik: --Hach mamin rey, ha smul winh wune' chi', emokab' t'a wib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' hin k'ab' wok, palta mokab' t'a ib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh ha makb'en tz'emi, xchi ix.
Ix tak'wixi winh rey chi' t'a ix: --Ha mach snib'ej tzach ixtan chi', ik'kot t'ayin t'a tik yik wach' manhxo ol hach stzuntzok, xchi winh.

Palta ix ochnhej te'an ix t'a winh rey chi': --Tzin tewi t'ayach mamin rey, to tzak' ha ti' t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal to ha jun hin k'ab' wok snib'ej yak'anek' spak schamel winh wune' chi', mokab' smilcham junxo wune' chi', yik max te jawi kuselal t'a wib'anh, xchi ix. Ix tak'wi winh rey chi': --Swak' hin ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to malaj jab'ok tas ol ik'an winh une' chi', xchi winh.
Ix ochxi ijan ix yalan icha tik: --Mamin rey, elokab' t'a ha k'o'ol to tza cha ab' jun b'elanh lolonel ol wal t'ayach, xchi ix. --Ala', xchi winh t'a ix.

Ix yalan ix icha tik: --Mamin rey, ¿tom manh wanok ak'an chukal t'a schonhab' Dios? Ayik ix halani to tza b'o yaj tas tz'aj winh wune', wan ha ch'oxaneli to manh tojolok ha pensar yujto maxtzak ha cha meltzaj winh uninal aykanb'at elelal t'a junxo ch'ok chonhab'il.

Yujto ko masanil ol honh chamok. Lajan honh icha ha ha' stob'b'at t'a sat lu'um, maxtzak yal ko molank'e'i, palta ha Dios manh komonok syik'el ko k 'inal, ha tas sk'ulej to say tas tz'aj smeltzajxikot heb' najat aykanb'ati.
Ha tikne'ik mamin rey, hin jawi ul wal juntzanh tik t'ayach, yuj heb' anima tzin xib'tan chi'. Yuj chi' ix hin koti yik tzin lolon t'a ichanh, k'inalok tza cha ab' tas tzin k'an tik mamin rey
to tzin ha kol t'a mach snib'ej tzin satanel yet' heb' wune' t'a sat lum lum ix yak' Dios ko makb'enok tik.

Ha hin ha chekab' waj tik, ol hin tanhwej tas ol aj ha pakan t'ayin yik wach' manhxa tas ol hin na'a, yujto ha hach tik mamin rey, ojtak wal ha ch'olb'itan tas yaji, tato wach', mato chuklaj, lajan hach icha junok ángel yik Dios. A'okab' Jehová ko Diosal ayoch het'ok, mamin rey, xchi ix.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a ix: --Ha tikne'ik ay tas ol hin k'anb'ej t'ayach. Malaj tas ol ha k'ub'ejel t'ayin, xchi winh. --Al an mamin rey, xchi ix.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winh rey chi' t'a ix icha tik: --¿Tom manhok winhaj Joab ixb'o'an al jun tik? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi ix: --Ichaton chi' mamin rey, ix ha na'eli. Ha winh ha chekab' chi' ix hin chekankoti, ha winh ix alanpax t'ayin tastak tzul wal tik t'ayach.

Ix sna juntzanh tik winh yik tope sk'exwi ha pensar t'a winh uninal aj Absalón. Palta ha hach tik mamin rey, te aj pensar hach, lajan hach icha wal junok yángel Dios, ojtak masanil tastak tzuji t'a yol ha makb'en tik, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ix awtaj winhaj Joab chi' yuj winh rey chi': --Toxo ix hin na'a, elokab'k'och icha tas tza nib'ej chi'. Ixik, b'at ik' meltzaj winhaj kelem Absalón chi', xchi winh rey chi' t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix em nhojan winhaj Joab chi' t'a yichanh winh rey chi' t'a sat lu'um, yuj sch'oxanel winh to niwan yelk'och winh rey chi' t'a sat winh. Ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik mamin rey, ix nachajel wu'uj to ay welk'och t'ayach, yujto ix ha cha ab' tas tzin nib'ej ix wal t'ayach, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Joab chi' t'a chonhab' Gesur yik b'at yik'anxikot winhaj Absalón chi' winh, yik sjax winh t'a Jerusalén.

Palta ix yalan winh rey to b'enhej sk'ochkan winh t'a spat, max jalaj winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'. Icha chi' ix aj sk'ochkan winhaj Absalón chi' t'a spat chi', maj k'ochlaj winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.
Ha t'a skal masanil heb' israel, malaj junok winak wach' yilji icha yilji winhaj Absalón chi'. Te b'inajnak winh yuj swach'il yilji chi', malaj jab'ok palta t'a sniwanil winh.
Jun'elnhej sjoxji'el xil sjolom winh t'a junjun ab'il, ayik ste alb'i syab' winh. Ha xil sjolom winh chi', ek'to chanhe' libra yalil, icha yechlab' heb' rey sk'ana'.
Ay oxwanh yuninal winh yet' jun yisil. Ha ix yisil winh chi', Tamar sb'i ix, te wach' yilji ix.
Schab'ilxo ab'il sjax winhaj Absalón chi' t'a Jerusalén, palta hanheja' max yal-laj sk'och winh t'a yichanh winh rey.

Yuj chi', ix awtaj winhaj Joab chi' yuj winh yik tz'ik'jib'at winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi', palta maj kotlaj winhaj Joab chi'. Ix yawtanxi winhaj Joab chi' winh t'a scha'elal, palta hanheja' maj kotlaj winh.

Haxo ix aji, ix schekanb'at heb' schekab' winhaj Absalón chi', ix yalan winh: --Ixikek b'aj ay smunlajel winhaj Joab t'a slak'anil sti' wiko', haton b'aj awab'il ixim cebada yuj winh, tze nhusantz'a tas awab'il chi' yuj winh, xchi winh. Ix b'at heb' schekab' winh chi', ix b'at snhusantz'a tas awab'il chi' heb'.
Ix b'at winhaj Joab t'a spat winhaj Absalón chi', ix yalan winh: --¿Tas yuj ix ha chekb'at heb' ha chekab' snhustz'a tas awab'il wu'uj? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Absalón chi' t'a winh: --Ix hach wawtej, yik sb'at ha k'anb'ej t'a winh rey tas yuj ix b'at hin kot t'a chonhab' Gesur. Te wach' hama, tato ix hin kanxonhej ta'. Hin gana swil winh rey chi'. Tato ay hin mul, syal hin smilancham winh, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Joab yal t'a winh rey tas ix yal winhaj Absalón chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix awtaj winhaj Absalón yuj winh rey chi'. Ayik ix k'och winh, ix em nhojan winh t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix chaji winh yuj winh rey chi', ix stz'ub'an sti' winh yuninal winh chi'.
Ayik ix ek' jun pekti', ix aj jun scarruaje winhaj Absalón stok'ji yuj nok' chej, ix sayan 50 heb' soldado winh yik stanhwaj winh yuj heb'.

Ak'walto sk'e wa'an winh t'a junjun k'u, tz'aj linhan winh t'a yol b'e sk'och t'a spuerta'il chonhab'. Yalnhej mach sjawi t'a winh rey yik sb'o'an yaj yowal, syamji'och wan heb' yuj winh, sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' tas chonhab'il heb'. Ayik syalan heb' tas chonhab'il heb', mach ay yinhtilal heb',
syalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Wach'ton tas tzul he b'o tik, smoj ton sb'o yaj t'ayex, palta malaj mach sb'o'an yuj winh rey chi', xchi winh t'a heb'.
Syalanpax winh icha tik: Ok hin wal tzin ak'ji'och juezal t'a jun chonhab' tik, ayik tzex jawi t'ayin he b'o yaj heyowal, elanhchamel am tzin b'o t'ayex, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ay junxo tas syutej heb' anima chi' winh, ayik wanto sk'och heb' t'a winh, ayik manto em nhojan heb' t'a yichanh winh, tz'och lak'naj winh t'a heb', stz'ub'anelta sti' heb' winh.
Ichanhej chi' ix yutej masanil heb' yetisraelal winh sk'och t'a winh rey yik sb'o yaj yowal. Icha chi' ix aj smontaj heb' anima chi' yuj winh.

Chanhe' ab'il ix sk'ulej winh icha chi', ix lajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, tzin k'an t'ayach to tzin ha chab'at t'a Hebrón, yik wach' tzin k'anab'ajej hin ti' wak'nak t'a Jehová.
Ayik ayinto ek' t'a Gesur t'a yol yik Siria, wak'nak hin ti' t'a Jehová, walannak t'ay, tato tz'el t'a sk'o'ol to tzin meltzaj t'a Jerusalén, yowalil ol wak' junok hin silab' t'ay, xchi winh.
--Ixik t'a junk'olal, xchi winhaj rey David chi'. Yuj chi' ix b'at winh t'a Hebrón chi'.

Ayik ix k'och winh ta', ix yak'anb'at schekab' winh t'a elk'altak t'a junjun yinhtilal heb' israel yik tz'alji t'a heb' to ayik ol yab'an heb' yok' nok' ch'a'ak, syalan heb' to toxo ix och winhaj Absalón reyal t'a Hebrón.
Chab' ciento heb' winh aj Jerusalén ix yik'b'at winh yet'ok. Ha heb' chi' malaj jab'ok tas yojtak heb' tas wan sna'an winh.

Ayik wan yak'an silab' chi' winh, ix schekan winh b'at ik'jokkot winhaj Ahitofel t'a schonhab', haton Gilo. Ak'um razón yaj winh t'a winhaj David. Ha jun tas ix sna winhaj Absalón chi' wan yoch yip yujto ix k'ib' sb'isul heb' anima ix och yet' winh.
Ay jun chekab' ix jawi yal t'a winh rey chi', ix yalan icha tik: Niwanxo heb' ketisraelal ayxo och yet' winhaj Absalón, xchi.

Yuj chi', ix yal winh rey chi' t'a masanil heb' yajal yaj yet' winh t'a Jerusalén chi': --Koyek, konh elek t'a winhaj Absalón chi'. Tato ma'ay, manhxo ol yal-laj ko kolan ko b'a t'a winh. Ko pilek kip yik manhxo ol honh yamchaj yuj winh yik tzonh smilancham yet' masanil anima t'a yol chonhab' tik, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ix tak'wi heb' t'a winh: --Mamin rey, ol ko k'anab'ajej tas tzala', xchi heb'.

Icha chi' ix aj yel winhaj rey David chi' t'a sti' chonhab', heb' ix yetb'eyum winh, heb' yuninal winh yet' pax heb' yetyajalil winh. Haxonhej lajunhwanh heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum winh ix kan stanhwej spat.
Ayik toxo ix el winh yet' masanil heb' anima chi', ix och wa'an heb' t'a sti'elxo chonhab'.

Masanil heb' yetyajalil winh, ix k'och heb' t'a stz'ey winh. Haxo pax heb' soldado stanhwan winh, haton heb' cereteo yet' heb' peleteo, t'a stzolal ix b'at heb' t'a yichanh winh yet' wake' ciento heb' soldado kotnak yet' winh t'a Gat.
Ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a winhaj Itai aj chonhab' Gat: --¿Tas yuj ipan hach tzach b'at ket'ok? Meltzajanh, wach' tzach kan yet' junxo winh rey ol och chi', yujto ch'ok chonhab'il hach.

Toto janak hach, max yal-laj hach wak'an pural ha b'at ket'ok, yujto ha hin tik manh wojtakok b'ajtil ol hin k'ochok. Wach' tzach meltzaji, ik'b'at heb' winh etchonhab' tik het'ok. Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a heyib'anh t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Itai chi': --Mamin rey, swak' hin ti' t'a yichanh Dios yet' t'a ichanh, yalnhej b'aj ol hach k'ochok, taxonhej tzonh chami, mato wach' tzonh aji, ol hin b'atnhej het'ok ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, xchi winh.
--Ichokab'ta', koyek, b'ab'lajanhek, xchi winhaj David chi'. Yuj chi' ix b'atnhej winhaj Itai chi' yet' heb' ajun yet' winh rey chi'. Ajun heb' yuninal winh rey chi' yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum winh.
Masanil anima, ayik ix yilan heb' sb'at winh rey chi' yet' heb' soldado, ix te ok' heb' sik'lab'il. Ix ek' heb' anima wan yel chi' t'a yol ha' Cedrón, ix b'at heb' t'a sb'e'al lum lum kuseltakxo.

Ajun pax winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Abiatar yet' heb' levita. Yet'nak te' skaxa'il strato Dios heb'. Ix yak'an em te' kaxa chi' heb' masanto ix yal slajwib'at heb' anima ix b'at yet' winh rey chi' t'a yol chonhab' chi'.
Ix yalan winh rey t'a winhaj Sadoc chi' icha tik: --Ik'ekxi'och te' kaxa t'a yol chonhab' tik. Tato ol och Jehová wet'ok, ol hin meltzajxok, ol wilanxi'och te' yet' skajnub' Jehová.
Tato maxtzak tzalaj wet' jun, ujokab' icha wal tas snib'ej t'ayin, xchi winhaj David chi'.

Ix yalanxi winh rey chi' t'a winhaj sacerdote Sadoc chi': --Hach schekab' Dios, meltzajanh t'a junk'olal yet' winhaj Abiatar yet' chawanh heb' heyuninal tik, winhaj Ahimaas, winh iko' yet' winhaj Jonatán winh yik winhaj Abiatar.
Ha hinxo tik, ol hin kan t'a spanhanil lum b'aj te kuseltakxo tik, masanto ol ja spekal t'ayin heyu'uj, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzaj winhaj sacerdote Sadoc yet' winhaj Abiatar t'a chonhab' Jerusalén chi', yet'nak te' skaxa'il strato Jehová heb' winh, ix k'ochxikan heb' winh ta'.

Ix k'e winhaj David chi' yet' heb' ajun yet' winh t'a lum tzalan Olivo, wan yok' winh sik'lab'il, malaj xanhab' winh ayochi, pichb'il sjolom winh yuj kusk'olal. Icha ix yutej sb'a winh rey chi', icha chi' ix yutejpax sb'a heb' ajun yet' winh chi'.
Ix alji t'a winh rey chi' to ha winhaj Ahitofel ayxo och winh yet' winhaj Absalón, yuj chi' ix sk'an winh t'a Jehová yik max elk'och tas na'b'il yuj winhaj Ahitofel chi'.

Ayik ix k'ek'och winh rey chi' t'a tzalan Olivo, b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'a Dios, ix jawi jun winh yamigo winh, haton winhaj Husai yinhtilal arquita. Ix jawi winh scha winh rey chi', nhik'chimtakxonhej spichul winh, ayk'e lum pokok t'a sjolom winh.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Tato tzach b'at wet'ok, tonhej tzin kan t'a spatik hu'uj.

Palta te wach' tato tzach meltzaj t'a Jerusalén tzalan t'a winhaj Absalón icha tik: Mamin rey, ha hin tik tzin kan ha chekab'ok icha ix aj woch schekab'ok winh ha mam, tato xa chi. Icha chi' ol aj och wet'ok yik max elk'och tas na'b'il yuj winhaj Ahitofel chi'.
Hata' ix kan winhaj sacerdote Sadoc yet' winhaj Abiatar chi'. Masanil tas ol ab' yalji t'a yol palacio chi', elanhchamel tzalb'at yab' heb' winh.

Hata' ay pax winhaj Ahimaas yet' winhaj Jonatán yuninal heb' winh chawanh chi'. Masanil tas tzab'i, ha t'a heb' winh tzalb'ati, haxo heb' winh ol alankot t'ayin, xchi winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Husai chi'.
Yuj chi' ix meltzaj winhaj Husai t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ayik ix k'och winh, wan wal yoch winhaj Absalón t'a yol chonhab' chi'.

Ayik ix b'at pilnaj winhaj rey David chi' t'a sjolom lum tzalan chi', ix jawi winhaj Siba schekab' winhaj Mefi-boset scha winh. Yet'nak chawanh nok' b'uru winh. Ayoch stz'um nok', ayoch 200 ixim pan t'a yib'anh nok', 100 b'uyanh takinh sat uwa, 100 kechanh takinh sat higo yaman yaji yet' jun tz'u'um yet'tal wino b'ut'an.

Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh: --¿Tas juntzanh het'nak chi'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Siba chi': --Mamin rey, ha nok' b'uru tik ol kuchan heb' al uninal. Haxo ixim pan yet' sat te te' sloji tik, yik heb' ha soldado yaji, haxo pax wino tik ol yuk'ej heb' sk'unb'i sb'ey b'aj kuseltakxo tik, xchi winh.

--¿B'ajtil ay winhaj Mefi-boset yixchikin winh ajalil aj Saúl tikne'ik? xchi winh rey chi'. --Ix kan winh t'a Jerusalén, yujto ix sna' winh talaj tz'och winh reyal icha ix sk'ulej smam icham yuj heb' israel, xchi winhaj Siba chi'.
