--Tato icha chi', ha tikne'ik ha masanil tastak ay t'a winhaj Mefi-boset chi', ol ikejkani, xchi winh rey chi'. --Mamin rey, ay hin t'a yalanh ha mandar, wach'okab' tzin kan t'a yol ha sat, xchi winhaj Siba chi'.
Ayik ix k'och winhaj rey David t'a Bahurim, ix elta jun winh skuchan Simei yuninal winhaj Gera, ayto yuj sb'a yet' winhaj rey Saúl chamnak.
Ix och ijan winh sb'ajwaj t'a winhaj rey David chi', ix julwajpaxkot winh t'a winh yet' t'a heb' yajal ajun yet' winh rey chi'. Oyanoch heb' soldado yet' heb' anima t'a spatik winh rey chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Simei chi' icha tik: --Jachel ha b'a t'a tik, hach milum anima.

Ha tikne'ik wan ha cha'an spak yuj Jehová yuj jantak heb' yinhtilal winhaj Saúl ha milnakchamok yik tzach ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha tikne'ik toxo ix yak'och opisio Jehová t'a yol sk'ab' winh uninal aj Absalón. Ix jawi t'a ib'anh tikne'ik yujto te milum hach anima, xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Abisai yune' ix Sarvia t'a winhaj rey David chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, ¿tas yuj sb'ajwajkot jun winh icha nok' chamnak tz'i' tik t'ayach? Cha hin b'ati, b'at hin xikel sjolom winh, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winh rey chi': --Malaj heyalan heyik t'a jun winh tik ha hex yune' hex ix Sarvia tik. Tato tzin sb'aj winh, ha am Jehová tz'ak'an yal winh. Tato icha chi', malaj mach syal skachanoch wa'an winh, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix b'at k'elan winh t'a winhaj Abisai yet' t'a heb' ayoch yet' winh yajalil, ix yalan winh: --Inatax ha wal winh wuninal snib'ej tzin milanchamok, okxom wal jun winh yinhtilal Benjamín tik. Hin sb'ajokab' winh, tekan ha Jehová tz'ak'an yal winh.
Talaj ol hin snakot Dios yuj hin kusk'olal tik, haxo ol ajok to ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a wib'anh sk'exulok tas tz'alji tik t'ayin, xchi winh.

Ix b'atxi winhaj David chi' yet' masanil heb' ajun yet'ok, hanheja' ix b'atpax winhaj Simei chi' t'a spak'ul lum witz chi', ix b'ajwajxikot winh, ix sjulankot k'e'en k'e'en winh t'a skal heb', ix slanhankot lum pokok winh t'a heb'.
Ayik ix k'och winhaj David chi' t'a sti' ha' Jordán yet' masanil heb' ajun yet' chi', te k'unb'inakxo heb', yuj chi' ix yik' yip heb' ta'.
Haxo winhaj Absalón yet' masanil heb' ajun pax yet'ok yet' winhaj Ahitofel, ix och heb' t'a yol chonhab' Jerusalén.

Haxo winhaj Husai arquita yamigo winhaj David, ix elta winh scha winhaj Absalón chi', te cha'anh ix awaj winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Niwanokab' elk'och mamin rey, hach ik'jokab' cha'anh, xchi winh.
Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Absalón chi': --¿Tom icha chi' tz'aj ha na'an t'a spatik winh amigo chi'? ¿Tas yuj maj hach b'at yet' winh? xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Husai chi': --Ma'ay, manh smojok tzin b'at yet' winh. Ha mach sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová, sik'b'ilpaxel yuj heb' chonhab' israel, ha yet' ol hin kanok.
Hanhejtona' ay mach smoj swak' serwil, ol wak' serwil winh yuninal winh wamigo chi'. Icha ix aj wak'an serwil winh ha mam, icha wal chi' ol aj hach wak'anxi serwil, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Absalón chi' t'a winhaj Ahitofel: --¿Tas tza na' ha hach tik, tas ol ko k'ulej? xchi winh t'a winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Ahitofel chi': --Ha tas tza k'ulej tikne'ik to tzach way yet' heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum winh ha mam aykan stanhwej spat, yik wach' snachajel yuj masanil heb' israel tik to tzach chakjikanel yuj winh ha mam chi', haxo masanil heb' ayoch et' tik ol hach yak'och heb' yipok sk'o'ol, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'o'ank'e jun mantiado heb' t'a spanhanil palacio, hata' ix way winhaj Absalón chi' yet' heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum smam chi'. T'a yichanh masanil heb' chonhab' chi' ix way winh yet' heb' ix.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ayik sk'anchaj razón t'a winhaj Ahitofel chi' ichato ha t'a Dios wan sk'anb'an heb', yuj chi' ha tas ix yal winh, ix yak'och winhaj rey David yipok sk'o'ol. Hanheja' icha pax chi' ix sk'ulej winhaj Absalón chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Ahitofel t'a winhaj Absalón chi': --Komonok syal ha k'o'ol tzin sik'el 12 milok heb' soldado, tzin b'at t'a spatik winhaj David t'a jun ak'wal tik,
yakb'an malaj yip winh yuj k'unb'elal, ol hin k'ochok. Ol hin xib'tej masanil heb' ajun yet' winh, masanil heb' ol el lemnaj t'a stz'ey winh. Malaj junok mach ol hin milchamok, anhej winh rey chi'.
Icha chi' ol aj yoch heb' anima smasanil het'ok, yujto junnhej mach yowalil smiljichamok, haxo masanil heb' anima chi', ol och heb' t'a junk'olal het'ok, xchi winhaj Ahitofel chi'.
Ix scha sk'o'ol jun pensar chi' winhaj Absalón chi' yet' masanil heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab'.
Ix yalan winhaj Absalón chi' to tz'awtaj winhaj Husai arquita, yik syal winh tas sna' winh t'a yib'anh jun tik.

Haxo ix k'och winhaj Husai chi', ix yalan winhaj Absalón chi' tas ix aj sna'an winhaj Ahitofel chi'. Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh: --¿Wach' am sko k'ulej icha syal winh tik, mato ma'ay? ¿Tas tz'aj ha na'ani? xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Husai chi': --Ha tas ix sna' winhaj Ahitofel t'a jun'el tik, manh wach'oklaj.

Ha hach tik ojtak wal to ha' winh ha mam te jelan winh t'a owal yet' masanil heb' winh ajun yet' winh. Ha tikne'ik te ay am kot yowal winh yet' heb' winh, icha junok nok' nun oso tz'ik'ji'ek' yune', icha chi' yaj heb' winh. Hanhejtona' pax winh ha mam chi' te k'aynak winh yak'an owal, manhoklaj t'a skal heb' anima chi' ayek' winh t'a jun ak'wal tik.

Ha tikne'ik, b'aj am sk'ub'ejel sb'a winh t'a junok nhak'e'en, ma t'a junokxo b'aj t'a chi'. Hanhejtona', tato t'a jun b'ab'el owal tik scham jaywanhok heb' ha soldado, axom wal yel spekal chi' to toxo ix ak'ji ganar heb' ha soldado.

Yuj chi' wach'chom ay heb' winh max xiwtaxon icha nok' niwak choj, palta yowalil schab'axk'e sk'o'ol heb' winh t'a icha chi', yujto masanil heb' ketchonhab' ojtannak to te jelan winh ha mam chi' t'a owal yet' heb' yet'nak winh chi'.

Ha jun tas swal t'ayach tikne'ik to sb'at ko molb'ejkot masanil heb' ketisraelal yik tz'och heb' het'ok, skot t'a Dan masanto t'a Beerseba. Ha heb' chi' manhxo b'ischajb'enok heb' icha yarena'il sti' ha' mar, ha hachxo tza kuchb'ej heb' t'a owal.

Slajwi chi', tzonh b'at kak' owal yet' winh ha mam yalnhej b'ajtil ayek'i, tzonh em t'a yib'anh winh icha yem yal ak'wal t'a yib'anh masanil anh ank'ultak. Manhxa junok heb' ayek' yet' winh chi' skani.

Wach'chom sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' t'a junok chonhab' yalani, palta ko masanil ha honh israel honh tik skik' ko lasu sko nherankot jun chonhab' chi' yet' jantak k'e'en k'e'en ayoch t'ay, skekankanb'at juynaj t'a yoltak ch'olan, manhxa junok k'e'en k'e'en skan ta', xchi winhaj Husai chi'.

Ix scha sk'o'ol winhaj Absalón yet' masanil heb' ichamtak winak tas ix yal winhaj Husai chi' t'a yichanh tas ix yal winhaj Ahitofel chi', wach'chom wach' ix sna' winh chi'. Ix scha sk'o'ol jun tik heb' yujto ha Jehová ix ak'an sna heb' yik max elk'och tas ix sna winhaj Ahitofel chi'. Icha chi' ix aji yik skot t'a yib'anh winhaj Absalón chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at yalan winhaj Husai chi' t'a winhaj sacerdote Sadoc yet' t'a winhaj Abiatar tas ix yal winhaj Ahitofel t'a winhaj Absalón chi' yet' t'a heb' ichamtak winak. Ix yalanpax winh tas ix aj yalani, yik b'at yal heb' yab' winhaj rey David t'a elanhchamel to max kanlaj heb' t'a lum tzinan lu'um chi' palta to tz'ek'kan heb' t'a junxo sk'axepal ha' Jordán yik wach' max miljicham heb'.

Haxo pax winhaj Jonatán yet' winhaj Ahimaas hato b'aj sk'e'ul sjaj ha' Rogel t'a stitakel chonhab', hata' ayek' heb' winh yik wach' malaj mach tz'ilan yek' heb' winh t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Haxo jun ix chekab', ix b'at halan t'a heb' winh t'a elk'altak tas yaji. Ixnhej wal yab' heb' winh, ix b'at heb' winh yal t'a winhaj rey David chi'.

Palta ay jun winh kelem unin ix ilan heb' winh, haxo winh ix b'at halan t'a winhaj Absalón chi', palta ix sna'el heb' winh schawanhil, yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh t'a spat jun winh kajan t'a Bahurim, t'a slak'anil chi'. Elanhchamel ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' winh t'a yol jun olan ay t'a yamak'il jun pat chi'.
Ha ix yetb'eyum winh aj pat chi', ix slich'b'at jun k'apak ix t'a yib'anh jun olan chi', ix sekanem ixim trigo ix t'a yib'anh yik max cheklaji.

Haxo ix k'och heb' winh schekab' winhaj Absalón chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a ix: --¿B'ajtil ix k'och winhaj Ahimaas yet' winhaj Jonatán t'a tik? xchi heb' winh. Ix tak'wi ix icha tik: --Hato wal yek'b'at heb' winh tik. Wan am wal sk'och heb' winh t'a sti' ha ha' chi', xchi ix. Ix komon b'at tzak'an heb' winh t'a spatik heb' winh chawanh chi' yalani, palta maj ilchajlaj heb' winh yuj heb' winh, yuj chi' ix meltzaj heb' winh t'a Jerusalén.

Ayik toxo ix meltzajxikan heb' winh chi', ix k'exta heb' winh chawanh chi' t'a yol jun olan chi', ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj rey David to sk'axpaj winh t'a ha' Jordán yet' masanil heb' ajun yet' winh chi', yujto toxo ix ak'ji sk'o'ol winhaj Absalón yuj winhaj Ahitofel yik skot heb' winh yak' owal yet' heb'.

Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj rey David chi', ix k'e wa'an winh yet' masanil heb' ajun yet' chi', elanhchamel ix k'axpajek' heb' t'a yol ha' Jordán chi'. Haxo ix k'inhib'i t'a junxo k'u, manhxalaj junok mach ayek' t'a sk'axepal ek'ta ha' chi'.

Ayik ix yilan winhaj Ahitofel chi' to maj ochlaj yopisio tas ix yal winh, ix yak'anoch stz'um schej winh, ix pax winh t'a spat t'a schonhab' b'aj aljinak. Masanil tastak ay t'a winh, ix sb'okan yumal winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix st'unhb'ank'e sb'a winh, ix cham winh. Icha chi' ix aj scham winhaj Ahitofel chi', ix mukchaj winh b'aj mukan smam.
Ix k'och winhaj rey David chi' t'a Mahanaim, haxo winhaj Absalón ix b'at winh t'a spatik winh, ix k'axpajpax winh t'a ha' Jordán yet' masanil heb' soldado israel.

Ix yak'och winhaj Amasa winhaj Absalón chi' yajalok heb' soldado sk'exulok winhaj Joab. Ha winhaj Amasa chi' yuninal winh jun winh ismaelita skuchan Itra, yik'lajnak sb'a winh yet' jun ix skuchan Abigail yune' ix Nahas snulej ix Sarvia, snun winhaj Joab.
Ix sb'ok'e scampamento winhaj Absalón chi' yet' heb' soldado t'a yol yik Galaad.

Ayik ix k'och winhaj David chi' t'a Mahanaim, ix jawi jaywanh heb' winh winak t'a winh, haton winhaj Sobi yune' ix Nahas aj Rabá t'a yol yik Amón, winhaj Maquir yuninal winhaj Amiel aj Lo-debar yet' winhaj Barzilai aj Rogelim t'a yol yik Galaad.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh chi', yet'nak alanh heb' winh yet' palangana, lum chen, ixim trigo, ixim cebada, ixim harina yet' ixim trigo mayb'il, anh awastut, anh lenteja,

yet'nakpax nok' yal chab' heb' winh, nok' queso, nok' crema yet' pax nok' kalnel. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yik'b'at heb' winh yab'lej winhaj rey David yet' masanil heb' ajun yet' winh. Yujto spetoj winh yet' masanil heb' anima chi' t'a tzinan lu'um, yuj chi' ix sna heb' winh icha tik: Tekan k'unb'inak yaj heb', tzam takjilaj sti' heb', tzam ochpaxlaj swejel heb', xchi heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix spojan snanhal masanil heb' soldado winhaj rey David chi', ix yak'anoch yajalil junjun mil yet' junjun cien soldado winh.

Ox makan ix aj spojanb'at heb' soldado chi' winh. Ha winhaj Joab ix och yajalil t'a jun makan, haxo t'a junxo makan, ha winhaj Abisai yuk'tak winhaj Joab chi' ix ochi. Haxo junxo makan jun, ha winhaj Itai aj Gat ix och yajalil t'ay. Ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a masanil heb' soldado icha tik: --Ol hin b'at heyet'ok t'a owal chi', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' winh: --Ma'ay mamin rey, max yal-laj ha b'ati, yujto ha heb' ajk'o'ol chi' ha hach tzach sayek' heb', ha honh pax tik ta tzonh kolchaji, ma tzonh cham nanhalok yuj heb', malaj kelk'ochi, palta ha hach tik ek'b'al sniwanil elk'och t'a yichanh 10 milok honh ha honh tik. Yuj chi' wach' tzach kan t'a yol chonhab' tik. Tato ay b'aj ijan tzonh ak'ji ganar, b'at honh ha kolo', xchi heb' winh.
--Ichokab'ta', ol hin k'anab'ajej tas tzeyal chi', xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix elul linhan winh t'a jun niwan spuerta'il chonhab' chi' yik syilan winh yelta heb' soldado t'a makkiltakil t'a stzolal.

Ix cham wal yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Joab, t'a winhaj Abisai yet' t'a winhaj Itai, haton heb' sat yaj t'a heb' soldado chi', ix yal winh icha tik: Yujto ay welk'och t'a he sat, yuj chi' malajokab' tas tz'utaj winhaj Absalón. Masanil heb' soldado ix ab'an tas ix yal winh chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at heb' smasanil t'a owal yet' heb' ayoch yet' winhaj Absalón chi'. Ix schalaj sb'a heb' t'a skaltak te te' t'a yol yik Efraín.
Ix ak'ji ganar heb' soldado winhaj Absalón chi' yuj heb' soldado winh rey chi'. Te niwan heb' ix cham t'a jun k'u chi', 20 mil heb' ix chami.
Ha t'a skaltak te te' chi' ix och owal, te niwan anima ix cham yuj satb'at t'a kaltak te' chi' t'a yichanh heb' ix xikjicham t'a k'e'en espada.

Ayk'e winhaj Absalón chi' t'a yib'anh jun nok' smula. Ayik ix schalan sb'a winh yet' heb' soldado winhaj rey David chi', ix meltzaj winh t'a spatik. Haxo ix aji, ha t'a yalanh sk'ab' jun te' mach' ix ek' nhiknaj nok'. Ix kan nhak'naj sjolom winh t'a skal xachul te' sk'ab' chi', ix kan lokan winh, haxo nok' chej chi' ix b'atnhej nok'.
k'okb'il wal ay jun winh soldado ix hilani, ix b'at yalan winh t'a winhaj Joab icha tik: --Lokankan winhaj Absalón t'a skal sk'ab' jun te' mach' ix wila', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Joab chi' t'a winh: --Tato ix il icha chi', ¿tas yuj maj ha wach' milejcham winh? Tato icha chi', yowalil swak' spak t'ayach, swak'an lajunhe'ok ciclo plata t'ayach yet' jun niwan tzek'ul, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Wach'chom tzak' junok mil k'e'en plata chi' t'ayin, max wak'och hin k'ab' t'a winh yuninal winh rey chi', yujto ix kab' wal tas ix yutej winh yalankot t'ayach, t'a winhaj Abisai yet' t'a winhaj Itai to malaj tas tz'utaj winhaj Absalón chi'.
Hanhejtona' tato ix hin milcham winh, tzam kotnhej t'a wib'anh yujto malaj junok tas k'ub'eltak t'a winh rey chi', ¿tom tzato hin ha kolo'? xchi winh soldado chi'.

--Nab'anhej swik'ek' tiempo het'ok, xchi winhaj Joab chi'. Ix yik'anb'at oxe' k'e'en yunetak lanza winh, ix b'at stekanoch k'e'en winh t'a spixan winhaj Absalón chi'. Yujto pitzanto winh, yuj chi' ix oymaj lajunhwanh heb' stanhwumal winhaj Joab chi' t'a spatik winh, ix swach' milancham winh heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' to spukhaj k'e'en trompeta yik mantzak b'at heb' soldado t'a spatik heb' yetisraelal chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anb'at sniwanil winhaj Absalón chi' heb', ix b'at yak'anoch heb' t'a yol jun olan t'a kaltak te' chi', ix k'ekan jun niwan b'ulanh k'e'en t'a yib'anh yuj heb'. Haxo pax heb' soldado winhaj Absalón chi' ixto kani, ix el heb' elelal, ix paxkan heb' t'a spat.

Ayik pitzanto winhaj Absalón chi', ay jun monumento yak'nak b'ojok winh t'a jun lugar skuch sch'olanil yik heb' winh rey. Ha sb'i winh ix yak'kanoch t'ay, yujto malaj junok yuninal winh tz'ak'ankan b'inajok: “Smonumento winhaj Absalón” ix sb'i'ejkani.
Haxo winhaj Ahimaas yuninal winhaj Sadoc, ix halan t'a winhaj Joab: --Swal t'ayach, cha hin b'ati yik b'at wal t'a winh rey to ha Jehová toxo ix kolanel winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yajk'o'ol, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --Max yal-laj ha b'ati, manh ha mojok ha hach ol b'at al jun lolonel chi', tope hato t'a jun'elxo ol hach b'atok, palta ha tikne'ik ma'ay, yujto ha wal winh yuninal winh rey chi' ix chami, xchi winh t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Joab t'a jun winh soldado aj Etiopía: --Ixik, al t'a winh rey tas ix il chi', xchi winh. Ix em nhojan winh aj Etiopía chi' t'a yichanh winhaj Joab chi', ix b'at lemnaj winh yal t'a winh rey chi'.

Ix yalanpax winhaj Ahimaas t'a winhaj Joab chi': --Elok wal t'a ha k'o'ol, cha hin b'at t'a spatik winh aj Etiopía chi', xchi winh. Ix tak'wipax winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --¿Tas wal yuj tza nib'ej tzach b'ati? ¿Tok ay tas ol ik' t'a jun lolonel chi'? xchi winh.

--Malaj yelk'ochi, wach'chom malaj tas swik' t'ay, palta ol hin b'at lemnajok, xchi winh. --Ixik an, xchi winhaj Joab chi'. Wal t'a jun rato chi' ix b'at lemnaj winhaj Ahimaas chi' t'a jun ak'lik, ix b'ab'laj winh yuj winh aj Etiopía chi'.

k'ojanem winhaj rey David t'a snanhal chab' spuerta'il chonhab' chi', haxo pax winh stanhwumal chonhab' chi', ayek' winh t'a spanhanil yib'anh smuro'al b'aj ayoch puerta chi'. Ix yilan winh skot jun winh winak sch'okojil, te yelk'olal skot winh.
Te cha'anh ix awaj winh, ix yalan winh to ay jun winh sjawi. Ix yalan winh rey chi': --Tato sch'okoj winh, alum wach' ab'ix winh syal chi', xchi winh rey chi'. Ayik lak'anxo sjawi winh,

ix yilan winh stanhwumal chonhab' chi' to tzak'an skot junxo winh, ix awaj winh t'a winh tanhwum puerta chi': --Ay wal junxo winh winak te yelk'olal skoti, xchi winh. --Hanheja' wach' ab'ix tzul yal junxo winh chi', xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix yalanxi winh stanhwumal chonhab' chi': --Ha jun winh b'ab'el chi' icha wal sb'ey winhaj Ahimaas yuninal winhaj Sadoc swila', xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winh rey chi': --Tato ha winh chi', wach' spensar winh, wach' am tas ol ul yal winh, xchi winh.

Haxo yik ix jawi winhaj Ahimaas chi' t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix em nhojan winh, ix yak'an stzatzil sk'o'ol winh rey chi' winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal, yujto ha heb' ix meltzajoch ajk'olal t'ayach, toxo ix satji'el heb' yuj Jehová, xchi winh.

--¿Wach'am sk'o'ol winhaj Absalón ix ila'? xchi winh rey chi'. Ix tak'wi winhaj Ahimaas chi' icha tik: --Toxonhej somsoman anima yik ix hin chekjikot yuj winh ha chekab' aj Joab, majxo wab'i tas ix uji, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: --B'esek' jab'ok ha b'a t'a chi', tzach kan ta', xchi winh. Ix sk'anab'ajan winh yochkan linhan ta'.

Hato wal chi' ix ja nhiknaj winh aj Etiopía chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, cha jun wach' ab'ix tzul wal tik t'ayach: Ha tikne'ik, toxo ix hach skolel Jehová t'a yol sk'ab' masanil heb' ix och ajk'olal t'ayach, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Xalpax winhaj kelem Absalón ¿wach'am sk'o'ol winh? xchi winh rey chi'. Ix tak'wi winh aj Etiopía chi': --Mamin rey, tzok wal kot t'a yib'anh masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach icha ix aj skot t'a yib'anh winh chi', xchi winh.

Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winh rey chi', ix och pitz'an t'a spixan winh, ix k'e winh t'a yib'anh b'aj ay spuerta'il jun chonhab' chi'. Wan sb'ey winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ay, ay hach wuninal aj Absalón. Komonok ha hin ix hin cham ha k'exulok, xchi winh.

Ix yab'an heb' anima to ha winhaj rey David ste ok' winh yuj schamel winhaj Absalón, winh yuninal, yuj chi' ha tzalajk'olal yuj b'aj ix yak' ganar owal heb' t'a jun k'u chi', ix meltzajkanoch t'a kusk'olal. Ha heb' soldado ix xit'ek' t'a owal chi', k'ixwelalxonhej ix aj sjax heb', elk'altakxonhej ix och heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi', ichato toxonhej ix el heb' t'a heb' ajk'o'ol chi'. Ha winhaj rey David chi', makan sat winh tz'el yaw winh: Ay hach wuninal aj Absalón. Ay hach wuninal aj Absalón, xchi winh. Ix yab' winhaj Joab to wan yok' winh rey chi' yuj winh yuninal chi'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winh b'aj ayek' winh rey chi' ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik wan ak'an k'ixwelal heb' ha soldado ix hach kolanel yet' heb' al uninal yet' heb' ix etb'eyum yet' heb' ix schab'il etb'eyum.

Wan ha ch'oxaneli to malaj yelk'och heb' etyajalil yet' heb' ha soldado t'a yol ha sat. Ha heb' ajk'o'ol yajoch t'ayach, te xajan heb' hu'uj, haxo heb' tzach xajanan tik, wan ha chakankanel heb'. Ha tikne'ik snachajel wu'uj, tekan wach' ix ab'i tato maj cham winhaj Absalón chi', ha honhxo pax tik jun, honh chamokab' ko masanil.

Yuj chi', ha tikne'ik elanhkoti, tzak'an sniwanil sk'o'ol masanil heb' ha soldado. Tato manh ol hach elok, wal t'a yichanh Jehová swala', manhxa junok mach ayek' het'ok ol k'inhib'ok. Tato icha chi', te chuk tas ol ja t'a ib'anh tikne'ik t'a yichanh tastak ek'nak t'a ib'anh yiktax kelem hachto, xchi winhaj Joab chi'.

Yuj chi' ix k'e wa'an winh rey chi', ix elta winh, ix b'at em k'ojan winh t'a sti' spuerta'il chonhab' chi'. Ayik ix alchaj yab' masanil heb' chonhab', ix ja heb' t'a yichanh winh. Haxo pax heb' israel ayoch yet' winhaj Absalón, elelal ix aj spax heb' t'a spat.

Masanil makanhil heb' yinhtilal Israel chi' ix laj yal heb' icha tik: Ha winhaj rey David tik ix honh kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' kajk'o'ol, haxo tikne'ik, yuj winhaj Absalón, ix el winh elelal t'a ko makb'en tik.
Ha winhaj Absalón chi' ix ko komon ak'ejoch ko reyalok, toxo ix champax winh t'a owal. ¿Tas sko tanhwejek, yuj chi' max kik'xikot winhaj rey David chi' ko reyalok? xchi heb'.

Yuj chi', ha winh rey chi' ix chekanb'at aljok t'a heb' winh sacerdote, haton winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Abiatar icha tik: Alek t'a heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Judá icha tik: Toxo ix wab'i tastak wan yalan juntzanhxo makanhil heb' ketchonhab'. ¿Tas yuj tzak'anxo tze na' tas tz'aj hin k'ochxi t'a hin palacio?
Ayto wu'uj hin b'a heyet'ok, junnhej pax kinhtilal, ¿tas yuj tzak'anxo tzul hin heyik'xib'at t'a hin palacio? xe chi t'a heb', xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix yalanxi winh rey chi' to sb'at alchaj t'a winhaj Amasa icha tik: Ha hach tik ayto wu'uj hin b'a het'ok, yuj chi' ha tikne'ik, ha hach ol hach och yajalilok heb' soldado sk'exulok winhaj Joab. Tato max elk'och tas wan walan tik, a'okab' Dios tz'ak'ankot yahelal t'a wib'anh, xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj smontanxi heb' aj Judá chi' winh rey chi', junxonhej ix aj spensar heb', ix yalanb'at heb' t'a winh to smeltzajxikot winh yet' masanil heb' soldado.
Yuj chi' ix kot winh rey chi', ix jawi winh t'a sti' ha' Jordán. Ix smolb'ejpax sb'a heb' aj Judá t'a Gilgal yik tzul scha'anek'ta winh rey chi' heb' t'a yol ha ha' chi'.
Hanhejtona' pax winhaj Simei yuninal winhaj Gera aj Bahurim, t'a yinhtilal Benjamín, elanhchamel ix kot winh yet' heb' aj Judá, yik tzul scha'an winh rey chi' heb'.

Tzak'anoch mil heb' soldado yinhtilal Benjamín yuj winhaj Simei chi'. Haxo pax winhaj Siba, chekab' yaj t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Saúl, 15 heb' yuninal winh yet'nak yet' pax 20 heb' schekab' winh, ix b'ab'laj k'och heb' t'a winhaj rey David chi' t'a sti' ha' Jordán.

Elanhchamel ix k'axpajek' heb' t'a sjayil ha' yik syik'anek'ta heb' yuninal winh rey chi' heb' yet' ix yetb'eyum winh. Ix kolwajpax heb' t'a b'ajtak syal winh rey chi'. Ayik mantzak k'axpajek'ta winh rey t'a yol ha' chi', ix k'och winhaj Simei, ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, tzin tewi t'ayach to tzin ak' niwank'olal yik maxtzak ha nakot hin mul ix och t'ayach ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, ayik ix hach el t'a Jerusalén. Mokab' kot owal t'ayin.
Swojtakejeli to chuk ix wutej hin b'a, yuj chi' ha t'a yinhtilal José, ha hin ix hin b'ab'laj jawi ul hach hin cha mamin rey, xchi winh.
Haxo winhaj Abisai yune' ix Sarvia ix halan icha tik: --Ha winhaj Simei tik, smoj scham winh yujto ix skatab'ej winh rey sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová tik winh, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh rey chi' icha tik: --¿Tas wal heyoch ha hex yune' hex ix Sarvia tik t'a jun lolonel tik? Manhxo heyak' somchaj hin k'o'ol. Ha tikne'ik wojtakxo to ol hin ochxok sreyalok heb' wetisraelal, yuj chi' malaj junok mach syal scham t'a yol ko chonhab' tik tikne'ik, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Simei chi' icha tik: --Swak' hin ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to manh ol hach hin mil-laj, xchi winh.

Ix kotpax winhaj Mefi-boset yixchikin winhaj Saúl, ul scha winh rey chi'. Yiktax ix elkan winh rey chi' elelal, masanto ix meltzaj winh t'a junk'olal, malaj jun'elok ix sb'ikel yok winh, maj sjoxel-laj jab'ok snhitak xil sti' winh, maj sk'exel spichul winh.
Ayik ix el winhaj Mefi-boset t'a Jerusalén, ix kot winh scha winh rey chi', ayik ix schalan sb'a heb' winh, ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj maj hach b'at wet'ok? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Mefi-boset chi': --Mamin rey, yujto chuklaj wok, yuj chi' ix wal t'a winh hin chekab' aj Siba to syak'och stz'um nok' hin b'uru winh, tzin k'e t'a yib'anh nok' yik tzin b'at het'ok walani, palta ix smusej hin sat winh.
Ix yesejpaxel hin ti'ok winh t'ayach. Ha hach tik mamin rey, lajan hach icha junok Yángel Dios. Elokab' k'och tas tza nib'ej.
Wach'chom masanil yinhtilal hin mam wicham syal ha milanchamok, palta ix hin awtej wa'el het'ok t'a ha mexa, yuj chi' manhxalaj tas wach' walani, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Manhxalaj tas wach' kalani, toxo ix hin na to tza pukek' lum ha lu'um yet' winhaj Siba, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Mefi-boset chi': --Kanokab' lum lum chi' t'a winhaj Siba chi' smasanil, ha jun niwan yelk'ochi to tzalajk'olal tzach jax t'a ha palacio jun'elxo, xchi winh.
Hanhejtona' winhaj Barzilai aj Galaad, ix emta winh t'a Rogelim ix ul yilan winh sk'axpajkanek'ta winh rey chi' t'a yol ha' Jordán, yik spuklankan sb'a winh yet' winh.
Te icham winakxo winhaj Barzilai chi', 80 ab'ilxo sk'inal winh. Ayik ayek' winh rey chi' t'a Mahanaim, ix b'at winh yak'nhej swa'el winh rey chi', yujto te b'eyum winh.
Ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Konh wet'ok t'a Jerusalén, hata' ol hach ajnhej wet'ok, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Barzilai chi' icha tik: --Jayexonhej ab'il pitzan hin, nab'anhejxom tzin b'at et' t'a Jerusalén chi'.

Ayxo 80 ab'il hin k 'inal, maxtzak wab'laj swach'il tas tzin wa yet' tas swuk'ej, maxtzak yal-laj wilani tato wach' mato ma'ay, maxtzak wab'laj sb'itan heb' winh sb'itani yet' heb' ix sb'itani. Nab'axonhej am ipan hin swak'och hin b'a ha k'atk'ej.
Anhejto tzin k'axpajek' t'a yol ha' Jordán tik tzin b'at jab'okxo het'ok, swilan ha b'atkani. ¿Tasto wal yuj tzala' to tzin b'at het'ok t'a Jerusalén yuj spakok swach'il hin k'o'ol?

Yuj chi' elok t'a ha k'o'ol, tzin ha cha meltzaj t'a hin pat, haxonhej to tzin tanhwej hin chami, ol hin mukjok b'aj mukan hin mam hin nun. Anhej jun, ay jun ha chekab' syal ik'anb'at mamin rey, haton winh wuninal skuchan Quimam, ik'b'at winh, tzak'an ha wach'k'olal chi' t'a winh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh rey chi': --B'atokab' winh wet' an. Ichokab' chi' tz'aji. Yalnhej tas tza k'an yuj winh, ol wak' t'a winh, xchi winh.

Masanil heb' ajun yet' winh rey chi', ix k'axpajek'ta heb' t'a yol ha' Jordán, ix k'axpajpaxek' winh rey chi', ix stz'ub'ankanelta sti' winhaj Barzilai chi' winh, ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh winh, ix paxkan winh t'a spat.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh rey chi' t'a Gilgal, ajun winhaj Quimam chi' yet' winh yet' masanil heb' aj Judá, ajun pax nanhalxo heb' israel.

Masanil heb' soldado israel ix b'at ilan winh rey chi', ix yalan heb' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj anhej heb' ketchonhab' yinhtilal Judá ix hach ik'ankoti, ix hach ik'anek'ta t'a yol ha' Jordán yet' heb' ix etb'eyum yet' pax heb' uninal yet' masanil heb' ha soldado? xchi heb'.

Haxo heb' aj Judá chi' ix tak'wi t'a heb' yetisraelal chi': --Yujto ha winh rey tik ayto ku'uj ko b'a yet' winh, yuj chi' max yal-laj skot heyowal t'ayonh, ¿tok ha t'a spatik winh tzonh wa'i? ¿tokwal ay jab'ok ko ganar yet' winh? xchi heb'.

Ix tak'wi heb' yetisraelal heb' chi' t'ay: --Wach'chom icha chi', palta ha honh tik lajunh makan inhtilal honh t'a heyichanh, yuj chi' te ay kalan kik t'a winh t'a heyichanh. ¿Tas yuj tzonh he patikejkani? ¿Tom manhok honh ix ko b'ab'laj alej to smeltzajxi winh ko reyal? xchi heb'. Palta ha heb' aj Judá chi', ek'to te ya tas ix yal heb' t'a heb' yetisraelal chi'.

Ay jun winh winak yelxo te chuk spensar t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Benjamín skuchan Seba yuninal winhaj Bicri. Ix spu nok' sch'a'ak winh, ix k'e somnaj heb' anima chi' yuj winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha honh tik malaj kalan kik t'a winhaj David yuninal winhaj Isaí tik. Konh paxek t'a ko pat ko masanil ha honh israel honh tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Yuj chi', masanil heb' israel chi' ix aktankan winhaj rey David chi', haxo yet' winhaj Seba chi' ix b'at heb'. Haxo heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Judá, ix kannhej heb' yet' winh rey chi', ix kot heb' yet' winh t'a sti' ha' Jordán masanto t'a Jerusalén.

Ayik ix jax winhaj rey David chi' t'a spalacio t'a Jerusalén, ix yik'anelta lajunhwanh heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum winh, haton heb' ix aykan stanhwej spat winh chi', ch'ok junxo pat b'aj ix tanhwaj heb' ix. Toxonhej ix ak'ji tas swa heb' ix, palta majxo waylaj winh yet' heb' ix. Hata' ix kannhej heb' ix masanto ix cham heb' ix, icha heb' ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum ix ajkan heb' ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Amasa: --B'at molb'ejkot masanil heb' winh winak yik Judá, haxo chab'ej tzach jawi yet' heb' winh t'a tik, xchi winh.
Ix b'at winhaj Amasa chi' smolb'ej heb' winh, palta ix ek' tiempo, maj jalaj winh icha wal sk'uhal yaj yalankan heb' winh chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a winhaj Abisai: --Tekan to ek'b'al ol honh yixtej winhaj Seba tik t'a yichanh icha ix sk'ulej winhaj Absalón. Yuj chi' kuchb'ej masanil heb' soldado, tzach b'at t'a spatik winh, haxo talaj tz'aji tz'och winh skol sb'a t'a junok chonhab' ayoch smuro'al, tz'el winh t'ayonh, xchi winh.
Masanil heb' soldado yik winhaj Joab yet' heb' cereteo, heb' peleteo yet' juntzanhxo heb' soldado te jelan, ix el heb' t'a Jerusalén, ix b'at heb' yet' winhaj Abisai chi' t'a spatik winhaj Seba chi'.

Ayik ix k'och heb' t'a slak'anil jun niwan tenam ay t'a Gabaón, hata' ix schalaj sb'a winhaj Amasa chi' yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Joab ayoch spichul winh yik owal, ayoch jun cincho t'a snanhal winh. Ha t'a snanhal winh chi' jachanoch jun k'e'en espada ayem t'a yol yatut. Ayik wan sk'och winh yak' stzatzil sk'o'ol winhaj Amasa chi', ix k'eta jasnaj k'e'en yespada winh chi', ix sik'anxik'e k'e'en winh.
Ix syaman xil sti' winhaj Amasa chi' winh yet' swach' k'ab' yik stz'ub'anelta sti' winh winh, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh: --¿Wach' am ix hach ajelk'och wuk'tak? xchi winhaj Joab chi'.

Ha winhaj Amasa chi' max snalaj winh yuj k'e'en espada ix sik'ixk'e winhaj Joab chi'. Haxo ix aji, ix stipanoch k'e'en winh t'a sk'o'ol winhaj Amasa chi'. Ix elta lanhnaj yol sk'o'ol winh smasanil t'a sat lu'um. Junnhej ix yak' winhaj Joab chi' t'a winh, ix cham winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Joab chi' yet' winh yuk'tak chi', haton winhaj Abisai t'a spatik winhaj Seba chi'.

Ay jun winh t'a skal heb' soldado winhaj Joab chi' ix och linhan t'a stz'ey sniwanil winhaj Amasa chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha mach ayoch yet' winhaj Joab yet' pax winhaj rey David, ochokab' tzak'an yuj winhaj Joab chi', xchi winh.

Ix kan telan sniwanil winhaj Amasa chi' t'a skal schik'il t'a yol b'e chi'. Ayik ix yilan jun winh soldado chi' to ayik wan yek'ta heb' soldado t'a stz'ey sniwanil winhaj Amasa chi', tz'och linhan heb' yila', yuj chi' ix snherkanel winh t'a ti' b'e, ix slich'anb'at jun k'apak winh t'a yib'anh.
Ayik toxo ix snherkanel winh chi', ix ek'b'at heb' soldado smasanil, ix b'at heb' yet' winhaj Joab say winhaj Seba chi'.

Ha winhaj Seba chi', ix ek' winh smolb'ej heb' soldado t'a junjun makan yinhtilal heb' israel, masanto ix k'och winh t'a Abel-bet-maaca. Haxo masanil heb' yinhtilal Bicri tzak'anxo och heb' yuj winh, ix och heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi'.

Ayik ix k'och heb' soldado winhaj Joab t'a Abel-bet-maaca chi', ix oymaj heb' t'a spatik, ix sb'o'anoch lum lum heb' stek'nub'ok t'a spatiktak smuro'al chonhab' chi', yik syak'an owal heb' t'ay. Ix och ijan heb' smak'anem weknaj smuro'al chi'.

Hata' ay jun ix ix te ay spensar, ix k'e ix t'a yib'anh smuro'al chonhab' chi', ix yalan ix icha tik: --Ab'ek, ab'ek tas ol wala'. Alek t'a winhaj Joab chi' to skot winh t'a tik, yujto tzin nib'ej tzin lolon yet' winh, xchi ix.

Ayik ix k'och winh t'a slak'anil ix, ix sk'anb'an ix icha tik: --¿Tom ha hach tik hach Joab? xchi ix t'a winh. --Ha hin toni, xchi winh. Ix yalanxi ix t'a winh: --Ab' tas ol wal ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, xchi ix. --Tik swab'i, xchi winh.
Ix syamanoch ix yalan icha tik: --Ha t'a peka' tz'alji icha tik: Ha mach snib'ej syojtakejel junok tasi, sk'anb'ejokab' t'a chonhab' Abel, xchi. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'o yaj junok tasi.

Ha honh kajan honh t'a jun ko chonhab' tik, ichnhej ta' kajek'i, k'anab'ajum honh t'a sk'ayb'ub'al Dios. Te niwan pax yelk'och jun ko chonhab' tik. Palta ha hachxo tik tza nib'ej tza sateli. ¿Tas yuj tza nib'ej tza satel tastak to yik Jehová yaji? xchi ix.
Ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --Manh ichokta' wan hin na'ani yik tzin sataneli.

Manhok jun chi' sko saya', palta ha jun winh skuchan Seba yuninal winhaj Bicri aj tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín sko saya'. Ha jun winh chi' ix k'e wa'an winh ajk'olal t'a winhaj rey David. Anhej winh tzeyak' t'a yol ko k'ab', tzonh el t'a jun chonhab' tik, xchi winh. --T'a yib'anh muro tik ol ko julem sjolom winh t'ayach, xchi ix.

Yuj sjelanil spensar ix chi', ix b'at ix smontej heb' yetchonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix stzepanel sjolom winhaj Seba chi' heb', ix sjulanemta heb' t'a winhaj Joab chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh to spukhaj nok' ch'a'ak yik tz'el heb' t'a jun chonhab' chi', yuj chi' ix paxkan junjun heb' soldado t'a spat, ix meltzajpaxkan winhaj Joab chi' t'a Jerusalén yik b'at lolon winh yet' winh rey chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj skanxi winhaj Joab chi' yajalil t'a skal masanil heb' soldado yik Israel, haxo pax winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada, ha winh yajal yaj t'a heb' cereteo yet' t'a heb' peleteo.
Ha winhaj Adoram tz'ilan heb' aynhejkanoch sb'o'an munlajel, haxo winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Ahilud tz'ib'um yaj winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Ha winhaj Seva stz'ib'an yab'ixal winh rey chi' t'a stzolal. Haxo winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Abiatar, sacerdote yaj heb' winh.
Haxo pax winhaj Ira, aj chonhab' Jair, sacerdote yaj winh t'a winhaj rey David chi'.

Ha t'a yol stiempo'al winhaj rey David, oxe' ab'il ix yak' jun wejel. Ix sk'anb'an winhaj David chi' t'a Jehová tas yuj icha chi' tzuji. Ix yalan Jehová chi' icha tik: Wan heyab'an sya'il yuj jun wejel tik, yuj smul winhaj Saúl yet' yinhtilal, yujto smilnakcham heb' gabaonita winh, xchi.

Yuj chi' ix yawtej heb' gabaonita chi' winh rey chi' yik slolon winh yet' heb'. (Ha heb' gabaonita chi', manh israelok heb', amorreo heb', aykan heb' t'a skal heb' israel chi', yujto ix yak' sti' heb' israel chi' to max satel heb' gabaonita chi' heb'. Palta haxo winhaj Saúl, ix yak'lej winh satanel heb' yuj swach'ilok heb' israel yet' heb' aj Judá yalani.)

Ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a heb': --¿Tas wach' tzin k'ulej heyet'ok? ¿Tas spak swak' t'ayex yuj b'aj ix hex ixtaxi, yik wach' syak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a kib'anh ha honh schonhab' honh tik? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' gabaonita chi' icha tik: --Ha kowal yet' winhaj Saúl yet' yinhtilal, malaj sb'onab'il, max b'olaj yet' k'e'en tumin, malaj kalan kik ko milancham junok hex, xchi heb'. Ix yalanxi winhaj rey David chi' t'a heb': --Alek t'ayin an, tas tze nib'ej swak' t'ayex, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' icha tik: --Ko gana tzak'och ukwanhok yinhtilal winhaj Saúl t'a yol ko k'ab', yujto snib'ejnak winh honh sateli yik wach' max honh kan t'a he kal ha hex israel hex tik.

Ha heb' ukwanh chi' ol ko milcham heb', ol kak'ank'e lokan heb' t'a yichanh Jehová t'a Gabaa t'a schonhab' winhaj Saúl chi', haton winh sik'nakoch Jehová reyal, xchi heb'. Ix stak'wej winhaj rey David chi' yak'an t'a heb'.

Maj ak'jilaj winhaj Mefi-boset t'a yol sk'ab' heb', haton winh yuninal winhaj Jonatán yixchikin winhaj Saúl, yujto yak'nak sti' winhaj David t'a winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a yichanh Jehová to manh ol miljokcham yinhtilal winh.

Ix schekan winh rey chi' yamchaj winhaj Armoni yet' junxo winh skuchan Mefi-boset, haton heb' winh yuninal winhaj Saúl yet' ix Rizpa yisil winhaj Aja. Ix schekan winh yamchajpax owanh heb' winh yune' ix yisil winhaj Saúl chi' skuchan Merab, haton heb' winh yune' ix yet' winhaj Adriel, yuninal winhaj Barzilai aj Mehola.

Ix ak'ji'och heb' winh ukwanh chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Gabaón chi'. Ix ak'jik'e lokan heb' winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a jolom witz. Icha chi' ix aj scham heb' winh ukwanh chi' t'a stiempo'al yel yich sjochchaj ixim cebada.

Haxo ix Rizpa chi' ix lich'anem jun icha nok' lopil t'a sjolom jun k'e'en k'e'en, ix kan ix stanhwej sniwanil heb' winh chamnak chi'. Ix kannhej ix ta' yik ix el yich sjochchaj ixim cebada, masanto ix jawi nhab'il k 'inal. Max scha emlaj nok' ostok ix t'a sniwanil heb' winh chi' t'a k'uhalil, max schapaxk'ochlaj nok' chi'um nok' ix t'ak'walil.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj rey David tastak sk'ulej ix Rizpa chi',

ix schekan winh b'at ik'jokkot sb'akil winhaj Saúl yet' yik winh yuninal, haton winhaj Jonatán, t'a chonhab' Jabes t'a yol yik Galaad. Yujto ha heb' aj Jabes chi' xit' ik'jinakkot t'a slak'anil mercado yik Bet-sán, b'aj lokankank'e yuj heb' filisteo, ayik smiljicham heb' t'a owal t'a Gilboa.
Ix schekan winh rey chi' ik'jokkot sb'akil heb' winh chi' yet' pax sb'akil heb' winh ukwanh ix k'e lokan chi'.

Ix mukji sb'akil heb' winh chi' t'a Zela t'a yol yik Benjamín, haton b'aj mukan winhaj Cis smam winhaj Saúl chi'. Ix uji masanil tas icha ix aj yalan winh rey chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yab' Dios tas ix k'anchaj t'ay yuj swach'ilok chonhab'.
Ix yak'anxi owal heb' filisteo yet' heb' israel, yuj chi' ix b'atxi winhaj rey David chi' yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb', palta ix te k'unb'i winh rey chi'.

Ay jun winh skuchan Isbi-benob, yinhtilal heb' cha'anh ste'el, ix snib'ej winh smilcham winh rey chi'. Ha k'e'en slanza winh, ek'to uke' libra yalil k'e'en, haxo t'a jun cincho winh ayoch t'a snanhal lokanoch jun k'e'en espada ak'to.

Haxo winhaj Abisai yune' ix Sarvia ix kolan winhaj rey David chi'. Ix smilancham jun winh filisteo chi' winh, yuj chi' ix yak' sti' heb' soldado t'a winhaj David chi' icha tik: Manhxo ol hach ko chab'at ket' t'a owal, yik wach' max hach chami, yujto ha hach ayachoch yipok ko k'o'ol ha honh israel honh tik, xchi heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anxi owal heb' israel yet' heb' filisteo t'a Gob. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ha winhaj Sibecai aj Husa ix milancham winhaj Saf yinhtilal heb' cha'anh ste'el.

Hanheja' t'a Gob chi' ix ochpax junxo owal yet' heb' filisteo chi'. Ha winhaj Elhanán yuninal winhaj Jaare-oregim aj Belén, ix milancham winhaj Goliat aj Gat. Ha ste'al slanza jun winh chi', lajan spatik icha te te' b'aj tz'och anh ch'al t'a te' jal-lab'.
Ix ochpax junxo owal t'a Gat. Ay jun winh te cha'anh ste'el ta', yinhtilal heb' cha'anh ste'el. Ha jun winh chi', lajchawe' yiximal sk'ab' winh, lajchawe' pax yiximal yok winh.
Ix te b'uchwaj winh t'a heb' soldado Israel, palta ix miljicham winh yuj winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Simea yuk'tak winhaj rey David.
Ha heb' winh chanhwanh chi', ha winhaj Refa aj Gat ay yinhtilal heb', palta ix ak'ji ganar heb' winh yuj winhaj rey David yet' heb' soldado.
Ha winhaj David ix b'itan jun b'it tik t'a Jehová ayik ix kolchajel winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj rey Saúl yet' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol t'a winh.
Mamin Jehová, ichato nhak'e'en aj t'ayin, ichato hin cuartel aji, yujto hin Kolumal hach.

Hach hin Diosal, ha t'ayach skot wip, ha t'ayach tzin kol hin b'a, hin Tanhwumal aji. Hin Kolumal hach, te ay ha poder. Hu'uj max hin yamchajlaj yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Ha hach ix hin ha kol t'a mach snib'ej hin sataneli.
Smojton wal ha b'itaji. Ayik swalan hin b'a t'ayach, t'a wal elanhchamel tzin ha kolankanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol yajoch t'ayin.
Ha smay chamel ix oymaj t'a hin patik. Manh jantakok yahelal ix jawi t'a wib'anh yik tzin sateli.
Ha chamel, ichato toxo ix spixoch slasu t'ayin, ichato ix sb'o hin ya'alil yik tzin telwi.
Mamin Jehová, ix wal hin b'a t'ayach ayik ayinek' t'a skal hin somk'olal. Hach hin Diosal, ix hin k'an ha kolwal. Ha t'a ha kajnub' ix ab' tas ix wala'. Ix k'och waw t'a ha chikin.
Ichato ix ek' jun niwan kixkab' te ow. Ix te ib'xi sb'akhnub'al satcha'anh. Ix tzikub'tanhaj wal yuj yowal ha k'o'ol hach hin Diosal.
Ichato ix elta tab' t'a yol ha nhi', haxo t'a yol ha ti' ichato ix elta jun k'ak' te ow. Ichato ix elta tzipipok tzak'ak' t'a yol ha ti' chi'.
Ix ha jak satcha'anh, ix hach emuli. Ayoch niwak k'ik'al asun t'a yalanh ok ayik hach emul chi'.
Ay hach k'e t'a yib'anh jun querubín, ix hach b'at jenhenhok, ix hach b'at b'akhachok t'a yib'anh ik'.
k'ub'an hach el b'aj te k'ik'k 'inal. Ix ha k'ub'ejel ha b'a t'a skal k'ik'al asun b'ut'jinakel yuj ha ha'.
Hach hin Diosal, yuj skopopi'al ha tzikiki'al ix scha sk'ak'al juntzanh tzak'ak' chi'.
Mamin Jehová, ek' hachto t'a yib'anh smasanil, ix el aw icha wal sk'anh k'u t'a satcha'anh. Ix kot sakb'at yet' tzak'ak'.
Ix ak'anb'at ha jul-lab', haxo heb' ajk'o'ol ix saklemkanb'at heb' yuj. Ix ha julanb'at jun k'ak' tz'ek' kopnaj t'a skal heb', ix pechchaj heb' yuj.
Mamin Jehová, yuj scha'anhil ix hach awaji yuj pax jun ik' te ow ix ak'elta, ix cheklaj yich ha' mar. Yuj pax chi' ix cheklaj yich yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Hach hin Diosal, masanto t'a satcha'anh ix ak'kot ha kolwal t'ayin, ichato ix hin ik'k'eta t'a yol jun ha ha' te jul yich.
Ix hin ha kolan t'a heb' ajk'o'ol te ay yip, malaj tzin och t'a heb', yelxo wal te tek'an heb' t'a wichanh.
Ix och b'ulnaj heb' t'ayin ayik ay hin och t'a ilk'olal, ha hachxo Jehová ix hach och wet'ok.
Ix hin ik'anelta b'aj lot'an, ix hin ak'ankanoch b'aj lewan. Ix hin ha kolo' yujto xajan hin hu'uj.
Mamin Jehová, ix ak' spak t'ayin yujto tojol ix wutej hin b'a. Ix ak' ha wach'k'olal t'ayin, yujto malaj hin mul,
yujto tzin k'anab'ajej ha b'eyb'al. Hach hin Diosal, max hin k'ulejlaj chukal, malaj hin gana swik'kanel hin b'a t'ayach.
Na'annhej masanil ha k'ayb'ub'al wu'uj, malaj b'ak'inh sb'at ha lolonel satk'olal wu'uj.
Wach'nhej hin b'eyb'al t'a ichanh. Ix hin ya'ilej hin b'a yik max hin b'at t'a chukal.
Yujnhejton chi' ix ak' spak t'ayin yujto tojol swutej hin b'a, malaj pax hin mul t'a ichanh hach Jehová.
Mamin, ha heb' tzach k'anab'ajani, ol elk'och syal ha lolonel t'a heb'. Ha heb' wach' spensar, wach' pax tzutej ha pensar t'a heb'.
Wach' tzutej ha b'a t'a heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, palta tza ch'ox ha jelanil ha tenanek' spensar heb' ixtum anima.
Tza kol heb' emnakil, haxo heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a, tzik'emta heb'.
Mamin Jehová, ha hachton tzak' sakil k'inal t'ayin. Ha hachton tzik'kanel k'ik' k'inal t'ayin hach hin Diosal.
Yuj ha kolwal ix hin saklemejb'at heb' soldado, ix hin k'axpajek' t'a yib'anh smuro'al juntzanh chonhab'.
Hach Jehová hin Diosal, yelxo wal te wach' ha b'eyb'al. Ha ha lolonel ix ak'kani, smoj ton wal malaj ko chab'k'olal t'ay. Tza kolel masanil mach yipk'olal aj yuj.
Mamin Jehová, malaj junokxo Dios, ha hachnhej. ¿Tokwal ay junokxo kolwajum icha hach tik?
Hach hin Diosal, ha hach tzak'nhej wip. Ha hach tzin ha kuchb'ej t'a jun b'e te wach'.
Icha sb'ey junok nok' k'ultakil chej, icha wal chi' tz'aj hin b'ey hu'uj. T'a sattak witz yek'i, tek'tek' waj hu'uj.
Ha hach tzin ha k'ayb'ej t'a owal, tzak'anpax wip yik tzin pakchitan junok jul-lab' nab'a bronce.
Mamin, ha hach tzin ha tanhwej, tzin ha kolani. Ha ha wach' k'ab' tzin yamank'e linhan. Yujnhej ha wach'k'olal ix hin ik'cha'anh.
Wach' ix utej hin b'e ha b'o'ani yik wach' max hin el-laj nhernajok.
Ix hin pech heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ix yamchaj heb' wu'uj. Maj hin ochlaj wa'an masanto ix cham heb' wu'uj.
Chok' ix wutejkan heb' yik wach' manhxo ol k'e wa'an heb'. Ix telwi heb' t'a skal wok.
Ha hachton tzak' wip yik swak'an owal. Ha heb' schichon sk'o'ol t'ayin, tzak' yak'em sb'a heb' t'ayin.
Ha hach tza pechel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Yuj chi' syal hin satanel heb' malaj tzin och t'ay.
Sk'an kolwal heb', palta malaj mach skolan heb'. Stewi heb' t'ayach Jehová, palta max hach tak'wilaj t'a heb'.
Chok' tz'aj heb' wu'uj icha wal lum pokok tz'ik'chajk'e wa'an yuj ik'. Tzin tek'anem heb' icha wal stek'chajem lum sok'om t'a yoltak b'e.
Tzin ha kolel t'a yowal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, tzin ak'ankanoch yajalilok juntzanh niwak chonhab'. Ha heb' anima manh wojtakoklaj, ha heb' tzin ak'an serwil.
Anhej syab'an wab'ixal heb', tzin sk'anab'ajan heb'. Ha heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi', syak'och sb'a heb' t'a yol hin k'ab'.
Tz'ib'xik'e heb' yuj xiwelal ayik tz'elta heb' t'a yol scuartel.
Mamin Jehová, pitzan hach. Hach hin Kolumal, alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach. Hach Dios hin Kolumal, ik'jokab' cha'anh ha b'i.
Ha hach tzak' yojtakejel heb' tzin ixtani to ayach och wet'ok. Tzik'ankot heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'a yalanh hin mandar.
Ha hach tzin ha kolel t'a yowal sk'o'ol heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, haton heb' schichon sk'o'ol t'ayin. Mamin, tzin ha kolanpax t'a heb' komonnhej smak'an anima.
Yuj chi' swal wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a skal juntzanh niwak chonhab', tzin b'itanpax ha b'i.

Hu'uj wal, swak' ganar niwak owal ha hin rey hin tik, ha hin sik'b'il hin el hu'uj. T'a masanil tiempo tza ch'ox ha wach'k'olal t'ayin, ha hin David hin tik yet' t'a heb' winhtilal icha ajnak halani, xchi winhaj David t'a sb'it t'a Jehová.

Haton juntzanh slajwub' slolonel winhaj rey David tik: Ha winhaj David yuninal winhaj Isaí, ix ik'jiwalcha'anh winh yuj Dios Haxonhej Ochi. Ix sik'ji'el winh yuj Dios chi' yik tz'och winh reyal t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob. Te wach' sb'itan winh t'a skal heb' yetisraelal. Ha winh ix halan icha tik:
Ha Yespíritu Jehová tz'ak'an wal juntzanh tik. Ha slolonel ayek' t'a hin ti'.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik, ko Kolumal paxi, ha ix halan t'ayin: Ha mach tz'ak'an yajalil t'a skal anima t'a stojolal, icha wal snib'ej hin k'o'ol,
lajan wal icha sakil yichcha'anh, ayik sk'e'ul k'u t'a junok k'u te k'achan, malaj asun. Lajan icha sk'achwi ayik toxo ix ek' junok yax nhab' tz'ak'an syaxil sat lum lum, xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Icha chi' ol aj winhtilal, masanil tas ix yal Dios t'ayin ol elnhejk'ochok, malaj b'ak'inh ol sk'ex tas ix yalkan chi' t'ayin. Ha Dios chi' ol kolwajnhej wet'ok yik tz'elk'och tastak tzin nib'ej.
Palta masanil heb' sk'ulan chukal, lajan ol aj heb' icha te' k'i'ix smolb'aji yik stakji, malaj junok mach syal syamani.

Tato ay junok mach snib'ej smolb'an te', yowalil sk'an junok k'e'en k'e'en, ma junok ste'al lanza yik smolb'ani, snhusjitz'a te' t'a yet'tal chi', stz'akanb'at te' jun'elnhej, xchi winhaj David chi' t'a slajwub'al sb'it tik.

Ha heb' winh soldado te jelan t'a skal heb' winh soldado winhaj rey David, oxwanh heb' winh: Winh b'ab'el, haton winhaj Joseb-basebet aj Tacmón. Ha t'a jun'el, 800 winak smilcham winh yet' k'e'en slanza.

Haxo winh schab'il t'a skal heb' winh oxwanh jelan chi', haton winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Dodo aj Aho. Ayek' winh yet' winhaj rey David chi' t'a Pas-damim, ix stzuntzejb'at heb' filisteo heb' winh ta' yik syak'an owal heb' winh, haxo yik ix kot heb' filisteo chi' t'a heb' winh, ix el lemnaj heb' yetisraelal heb' winh chi'.

Haxo winhaj Eleazar chi' ix stek'b'ej sb'a, ix smilancham heb' filisteo chi' winh, ix tzatzb'ikanoch b'uk'naj sk'ab' winh t'a yok k'e'en yespada chi'. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix k'anchaj winh yuj Jehová yik ix yak'an ganar owal chi'. Ayik toxo ix lajwi owal chi', ix meltzajxik'och heb' soldado israel chi' yet' winhaj Eleazar chi' yujnhej yik'anek' heb' masanil tastak yet'nak heb' ajk'o'ol ix cham chi'.

Haxo winh yoxil, haton winhaj Sama, yuninal winhaj Age aj Arar. Ayik ix smolb'an sb'a heb' filisteo t'a Lehi, haton b'aj awab'il juntzanh tut skuchan lenteja. Hata' ix el lemnaj heb' soldado yik Israel.
Palta ix stek'b'ej sb'a winhaj Sama chi' t'a skal juntzanh anh tut chi' yik skolankan winh. Ix smilancham heb' filisteo chi' winh. Ha winh ix k'anchaj yuj Jehová yuj yak'an ganar jun owal chi'.

Ha t'a jun'el, t'a stiempo'al smolji sat awb'en, ha heb' winh oxwanh sat yaj t'a skal heb' winh 30 soldado te jelan, ix b'at heb' winh b'aj ayek' winhaj David t'a k'e'en nhak'e'en yik Adulam. Haxo pax heb' filisteo, ayek' scampamento heb' t'a spanhanil ch'olan yik Refaim.
Ha t'a Belén, ay jun makan heb' soldado heb' filisteo chi'.
Haxo winhaj David chi' ix halan icha tik: Komonok ay mach tz'ak'an ha ha' skot t'a ha' uk'b'ila' ay t'a spuerta'il Belén wuk'ej, xchi winh.

Haxo heb' winh oxwanh soldado te jelan chi', ix och heb' winh t'a scampamento heb' filisteo, ix b'at yik'an ha ha' chi' heb' winh t'a spuerta'il Belén chi', ix yik'ankot ha' heb' winh t'a winhaj David chi'. Palta maj yal-laj sk'o'ol winh ix yuk'ej ha', tonhej ix sekem ha' winh t'a sat lu'um icha junok ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'a Jehová.

Ix yalan winh: Mamin Jehová, ¿tom ol wuk' wal jun ha ha' tik? Tato swuk'ej ha' icha wal to ha schik'il juntzanh heb' winh tik swuk'ej, yujto ix sb'ek sb'a heb' winh schami yik ix b'at yik'ankot ha' heb' winh, xchi winhaj David chi'. Yuj chi' maj yal-laj sk'o'ol winh ix yuk'ej ha'. Ha heb' winh oxwanh soldado te jelan chi', ha heb' winh ix k'ulan jun chi'.

Ha winhaj Abisai yuk'tak winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia, ha winh ayoch yajalilok 30 heb' winh soldado te jelan. Ha jun'el ix smilcham 300 winak winh yet' k'e'en slanza. Icha chi' ix aj sniwanb'i yelk'och winh, icha wal heb' winh oxwanh chi'.
Yelxo te niwan ix aj yik'jicha'anh winh t'a skal heb' winh chi', yuj chi' ix ochkan winh yajalilok heb' winh 30 chi', palta maj ochlaj winh stz'akub'ok heb' winh oxwanh b'ab'el chi'.

Haxo pax winhaj Benaía, yuninal winhaj Joiada aj chonhab' Cabseel, te jelan winh, tzijtum tas ix sk'ulej winh. Chanhwanh heb' soldado aj Moab te jelan ix smilcham winh. Ha jun'el ayik te ay k'e'en sakb'akom, ix em winh t'a yol jun k'e'en xab', ix smilancham jun nok' choj winh ta'.

Ay pax jun winh aj Egipto te cha'anh ste'el yet'nak slanza ix smilcham winh. Haxo winh anhej jun te te' yet'nak winh, ix b'at juknaj winh t'a winh aj Egipto chi', ix yik'anek' slanza winh chi' winh, haxo yet' k'e'en ix smilcham winh aj Egipto chi' winh.
Ha yuj tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Benaía chi', lajan ix aj yelk'och winh icha oxwanh heb' winh soldado te jelan.
Wach'chom niwan yelk'och winh t'a skal heb' winh 30, palta maj ochlaj winh stz'akub'ok heb' winh oxwanh chi'. Ix ak'ji'och winh yuj winhaj David yajalilok heb' stanhwumal.
Ha t'a skal heb' winh 30 jelan chi', ayoch winhaj Asael yuk'tak winhaj Joab, winhaj Elhanán yuninal winhaj Dodo aj Belén,
winhaj Sama yet' winhaj Elica haton heb' aj Harod,
winhaj Heles aj Palti, winhaj Ira yuninal winhaj Iques aj Tecoa,
winhaj Abiezer aj Anatot, winhaj Mebunai aj Husa,
winhaj Salmón aj Aho, winhaj Maharai aj Netofa,
winhaj Heleb yuninal winhaj Baana, winhaj Itai yuninal winhaj Ribai aj Gabaa t'a yol yik Benjamín,
winhaj Benaía aj Piratón, winhaj Hidai kajan t'a sti' ha ha' t'a yol yik Gaas,
winhaj Abi-albón aj Arba, winhaj Azmavet aj Bahurim,
winhaj Eliaba aj Saalbón, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jasén, haton winhaj Jonatán yet'
winhaj Sama aj Harod, winhaj Ahíam yuninal winhaj Sarar aj Harod paxi,
winhaj Elifelet yuninal winhaj Ahasbai aj Maaca, winhaj Eliam yuninal winhaj Ahitofel aj Gilo,
winhaj Hesrai aj Carmel, winhaj Paarai aj Arba,
winhaj Igal yuninal winhaj Natán aj Soba, winhaj Bani aj Gad,
winhaj Selec aj Amón, winhaj Naharai aj Beerot, skuchumal syamk'ab' winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia,
winhaj Ira aj Itra, winhaj Gareb aj Itra paxi,
yet' winhaj Urías hitita. 37 heb' winh tik t'a smasanil.
Ix kot yowal Jehová t'a chonhab' Israel jun'elxo, yuj chi' ix yak'och t'a spensar winhaj rey David yik syak' ik'jokcha'anh sb'isul heb' soldado yik Israel winh yet' heb' aj Judá.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Joab yajalil heb' soldado ayoch yet'ok: --Ek'anh t'a skal junjun makan heb' ketisraelal, skot t'a Dan masanto t'a chonhab' Beerseba, tzik'ank'e wa'an sb'isul heb' smojxo yoch soldado'al. Icha chi' ol aj wojtakani jantak heb' t'a smasanil, xchi winh t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Joab chi': --Mamin rey, a'okab' Jehová ko Diosal tz'ak'an k'ib' sb'isul heb' anima, 100 okab'to tz'ek' t'a yichanh icha tikne'ik, olto ila', palta, ¿tas wal yuj ha gana tzik'cha'anh sb'isul heb' anima tik? xchi winh.

Palta ix yak'xonhejoch winh rey chi' t'a yib'anh winhaj Joab yet' heb' yajalil heb' soldado to yowalil tz'ik'jik'e wa'an sb'isul heb' anima chi'. Yuj chi' ix elta heb' t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix sk'anab'ajan heb' sb'at b'aj ix alchaj chi'.
Ix k'axpajek' heb' t'a ha' Jordán, ix sb'o'ank'e scampamento heb' t'a Aroer t'a snanhal jun panhan. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' t'a Gad yet' t'a Jazer.
Ix b'at heb' t'a Galaad yet' t'a Cades t'a yol smakb'en heb' hitita. Ix b'atpax heb' t'a Dan, ichato chi' ix meltzaj heb' t'a stitak yik Sidón.
Ix b'atpax heb' t'a niwan chonhab' Tiro t'a smakb'en heb' heveo yet' pax schonhab' heb' cananeo. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at heb' t'a chonhab' Beerseba t'a Neguev t'a yol yik Judá.
B'alunhe' uj yet' 20 k'uhalxo ix yak' heb' yek' t'a smasanil, ix lajwi chi' ix meltzajxi heb' t'a Jerusalén.
Haxo winhaj Joab chi' ix ak'an sb'isul heb' anima t'a junjun chonhab' t'a winh rey chi': 500 mil heb' winh aj Judá to stiempo yoch t'a soldado'al yet' 800 mil yik juntzanhxo makan heb' israel.

Ixlajwi chi' ix sna'an sb'a sk'o'ol winhaj rey David chi'. Ix och winh t'a ilk'olal yuj b'aj ix yik'k'e wa'an sb'isul heb' israel chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin Jehová, te niwan hin mul ix och t'ayach yuj jun tas ix hin k'ulej tik. Ha wal tikne'ik tzin tewi wal t'ayach to tzik'el jun hin mul tik t'a wib'anh. Icha junok anima malaj spensar ix wutej hin b'a t'ayach, xchi winh.
Ayik ix sakb'i t'a junxo k'u, ayik mantzak k'e wa'an winhaj David chi' ix yalan Jehová icha tik t'a winhaj Gad schekab', haton winh ak'um pensar t'a winhaj David chi':
--Ixik al t'a winhaj David to ha hin Jehová hin swal icha tik: Oxe' makan yahelal swaltej t'ayach. Ha hachxo ol ha sik'lej b'aja junok tza nib'ej, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Gad chi'.

--Hinye, xchi winhaj Gad chi'. Ix ul yalan winh t'a winhaj rey David chi' icha tik: --¿Tzam yal ha k'o'ol sjawi uke'ok ab'il wejel t'a yol ha chonhab' tik? ¿Mato ha gana oxe'ok ujal tzex ak'ji ganar yuj heb' ajk'o'ol? ¿Ma ha gana oxe'ok k'uhal ilya yik scham anima t'a yol ha chonhab' tik? Na' wal sik'lab'il, ol halani. Slajwi chi' ol b'at walanxi t'a Jehová ix hin chekankoti, xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Maxtzak nachaj wu'uj tikne'ik tas tz'aj walani. Wach' tzonh kan t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, yujto niwan tz'ok' sk'o'ol t'ayonh, mokab' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima tzonh kani, xchi winh.

Yuj chi', ha t'a jun k'inhib'alil chi', ix yak'kot jun niwan ilya Jehová t'a skal heb' israel, masanto ix tz'akwi sk'uhal ix alchajkan chi'. Yuj chi' 70 mil anima ix cham t'a yol smakb'en heb' chi', ix kotnhej t'a Dan masanto t'a Beerseba.

Ayik ix yak'anb'at sk'ab' jun ángel t'a yib'anh Jerusalén yik syak' lajwok heb' anima yalani, ix kus sk'o'ol Jehová yuj tas ix uji chi', yuj chi' ix yal t'a jun ángel chi': k'okb'ilxo chi', ochokab' wa'an, xchi. Ha t'a stek'lab' trigo winhaj Arauna aj Jebús, hata' ayek' jun ángel chi' ayik ix alji chi' t'ay.

Ayik ix yilan jun ángel chi' winhaj David, ix yalan winh t'a Jehová: --Ha hin ton ay hin mul, malaj smul juntzanh anima tik. Tzin k'an t'ayach to ha t'a wib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh winhtilal tz'och jun niwan yahelal tik, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix jawi winhaj Gad yal t'a winhaj David chi' icha tik: --K'e'anh t'a stek'lab' trigo winhaj Arauna aj Jebús, tza b'o'an junok altar t'a Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix b'at winhaj David chi' icha ix aj yalan winhaj Gad yuj Jehová.
Ix yilankot winhaj Arauna to wan sk'och winh rey yet' heb' yetyajalil b'aj ayek'i, ix kot winh scha winh rey chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh winh.

Ix yalan winh: --Mamin rey, ¿tas wal yuj tzach jawi t'ayin? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi': --Ha yuj hin manan jab'ok lugar t'a ha tek'lab' trigo tik, ol hin b'o'ank'e junok yaltar Jehová t'ay, yik wach' ol wanaj scham anima t'a yol chonhab' tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Arauna chi': --Ujokab' mamin, b'o'okab'i, tzak'an silab' t'a Jehová icha wal snib'ej ha k'o'ol. Ay nok' wakax syal ak'an silab'il t'a tik. Ay te' mak'lab' trigo yet' te' yugo syal yoch k'atzitzal.
Ha hin tik swak' masanil juntzanh tik t'ayach, xchi winh. Ix yalanxi winh: --Tzok walel t'a sk'o'ol Jehová to scha yab' tas ol ha k'an t'ay, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Arauna chi' icha tik: --Ma'ay, ol hin man masanil juntzanh chi' t'ayach, yujto max yal-laj wak'an t'a Jehová ko Diosal tastak to tonhej tza si'ej t'ayin, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix sman jun lugar chi' winhaj David chi' yet' nok' wakax t'a 50 siclo k'e'en plata.

Ix sb'o'ank'e jun altar winh t'a Jehová, ix yak'an silab' winh snhusji yet' pax silab' yik junk'olal t'ay. Ichato chi' ix scha'an yab' Jehová tas ix sk'an winhaj David chi' yuj chamel wan yoch t'a yoltak schonhab' heb' israel. Yuj chi' ix wanaj jun ilya chi'.
